title: CDI - Responsable Logistique H/F
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at AMI PARIS
description_html:
Le Responsable Logistique assure le lien permanent et opérationnel entre les équipes internes d'AMI Paris et le Prestataire Logistique externe situé à Allonne (Oise). Positionné au cœur des deux organisations, il maîtrise l'activité pour garantir la bonne réalisation des opérations, pilote l'amélioration continue à travers des tableaux de bord, et veille au strict respect du contrat (taux de service, facturation, engagements réciproques).

 

MISSIONS ET RESPONSABILITÉS

Interface opérationnelle & Performance Terrain

  • Être le point de contact unique pour les services internes (ADV, Digital Ops, IT, Production) et assurer la résolution des demandes ad hoc.

  • Réaliser des audits terrain pour vérifier l’application du cahier des charges, des processus et des modes opératoires du prestataire.

  • Accompagner et challenger le prestataire dans une démarche d'amélioration continue (Lean, 5S).

Gestion des flux opérationnels (Inbound & Outbound)

  • Inbound : Garantir le référencement des nouveaux articles (création et disponibilité outils IT) ; assurer le lien avec les services responsables des commandes d’approvisionnement de l’entrepôt.

  • Outbound (Retail, Wholesale, E-commerce) : Assurer la bonne transmission informatique des commandes, piloter les priorités (implants, lancements, forecasts) et sécuriser les temps forts commerciaux (Soldes, Black Friday, Noël).

Suivi des stocks & Fiabilité

  • Piloter le bouclage des stocks (réconciliation des données ERP/WMS) et passer les écritures de recyclage dans l'ERP.

  • Contrôler les indicateurs de niveau de stock (taux de remplissage, d'occupation) et participer activement aux inventaires terrain.

Planification & Pilotage Financier

  • Animer le point de charge hebdomadaire avec le prestataire sur la base des prévisions (matrices hebdomadaires, mensuelles et annuelles).

  • Optimiser le plan de charge pour équilibrer les coûts et le niveau de service (gestion des campagnes de retour, des consommables, des VAS).

  • Assurer le contrôle mensuel détaillé de la pré-facturation et de la facturation réelle en lien avec le contrôle de gestion (unités d’œuvres, bonus/malus KPIs).

Gestion de projets Supply Chain

  • Participer au développement de projets logistiques transverses (promesse client, transport, emballage, ROI).

  • Piloter et déployer les projets de Value Added Services (VAS) : définition du planning, contraintes IT, cahier des charges et tarification.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ & COMPÉTENCES

Savoirs & Savoir-faire

  • Parfaite maîtrise des flux logistiques et des principes d’amélioration continue (5S, Lean).

  • Excellente maîtrise d'Excel (analyse de données complexes).

  • Anglais opérationnel.

  • Capacité à mettre en place un pilotage opérationnel fiable et à travailler en mode projet.

Savoir-être

  • Leadership et force de conviction.

  • Sens aigu des résultats, rigueur et autonomie.

  • Esprit de synthèse & d'analyse.

  • Réactivité, pragmatisme et persévérance.

Poste basé à Allonne (Oise) avec des déplacements ponctuels à Paris.

description_html:
Über die Tätigkeit

Authority baut ein Expertenpanel auf, um wichtige Entwicklungen auf den globalen Infrastrukturmärkten zu verstehen und vorherzusagen.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Fachperson, die aktuell im Infrastrukturmarkt in Deutschland tätig ist und über aktuelle Kenntnisse der lokalen Marktbedingungen verfügt.

Sie liefern praxisnahe Informationen zu Verkehr, Energie, Wasser, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Infrastruktur, einschließlich Projektpipelines, Finanzierung, Beschaffung, Regulierung, Umsetzung, Kosten, Betreibern und Investoren in Deutschland.

Ihre Marktinformationen helfen uns, Datensätze und Prognosemodelle zu verbessern, die kommerzielle Ereignisse, Marktveränderungen und Geschäftsergebnisse vorhersagen sollen.

Ihr Beitrag

  • Teilnahme an kurzen monatlichen Research-Gesprächen
  • Prüfung von Marktdaten auf Lücken und Fehler
  • Einordnung wichtiger Veränderungen im lokalen Markt
  • Bewertung der Wahrscheinlichkeit und des Zeitplans von Projekten, Investitionen und Nachfrage
  • Informationen zu Unternehmen, Investoren, Kunden und öffentlichen Stellen
  • Prüfung von Prognosen und Erklärung relevanter lokaler Signale

Relevante Fachgebiete

  • Verkehrs- und Mobilitätsinfrastruktur
  • Strom-, Netz- und Energieinfrastruktur
  • Wasser, Abfall und Umweltdienstleistungen
  • Telekommunikation und digitale Infrastruktur
  • Öffentliche und soziale Infrastruktur
  • Öffentlich-private Partnerschaften und Projektfinanzierung
  • Beschaffung, Regulierung und Konzessionen
  • Engineering, Bau und Anlagenbetrieb

Anforderungen

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung
  • Aktuelle Tätigkeit oder enge Einbindung in den Markt in Deutschland
  • Fundierte und aktuelle Kenntnisse der lokalen Marktbedingungen
  • Direkte Erfahrung mit kommerziellen, investitionsbezogenen, operativen oder strategischen Entscheidungen
  • Ein gültiges LinkedIn-Profil mit relevanter Berufserfahrung

Details zur Zusammenarbeit

  • Selbstständige Vertragstätigkeit
  • Remote in Deutschland
  • Etwa 2 bis 4 bezahlte Beratungsstunden pro Monat

Dies ist keine Vollzeitstelle, sondern eine flexible und bezahlte Expertenberatung.

Über Authority

Authority baut ein globales Expertennetzwerk und eine Plattform für Brancheninformationen auf, damit Organisationen Märkte besser verstehen und fundiertere strategische Entscheidungen treffen können.

About the role

Authority is building an expert panel to understand and predict important developments in global infrastructure markets.

We are looking for an experienced infrastructure professional who is currently active in the market in the United Kingdom and has up-to-date knowledge of local conditions.

You will provide practical intelligence on transport, energy, water, telecommunications and public infrastructure, including project pipelines, funding, procurement, regulation, delivery, costs, operators and investors in the United Kingdom.

Your intelligence will help improve datasets and forecasting models designed to predict commercial events, market changes and business outcomes.

  • Explain important changes in the local market
  • Assess the likelihood and timing of projects, investment and demand
  • Share intelligence on companies, investors, customers and public bodies
  • Review forecasts and explain the local signals that matter

Relevant expertise

  • Transport and mobility infrastructure
  • Power, grids and energy infrastructure
  • Water, waste and environmental services
  • Telecommunications and digital infrastructure
  • Public works and social infrastructure
  • Public-private partnerships and project finance
  • Procurement, regulation and concessions
  • Engineering, construction and asset operations

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience
  • Currently active or closely involved in the market in the United Kingdom
  • Strong and up-to-date knowledge of local market conditions
  • Direct experience with commercial, investment, operational or strategic decisions
  • A valid LinkedIn profile showing relevant experience

Engagement details

  • Independent contract
  • Remote within the United Kingdom
  • Approximately 2 to 4 paid consulting hours per month

This is not a full-time position. It is a flexible, paid expert consulting engagement.

About Authority

Authority is building a global expert network and industry intelligence platform to help organisations understand markets and make better strategic decisions.

title: Head of KYC  - CDI (F/H)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Lemonway
description_html:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

  • Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

  • Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (au choix)


LE POSTE

Le/la Head of KYC Operations est un acteur clé dans la mise en œuvre du système de lutte contre la criminalité financière de l’entreprise et de notre approche centrée sur le client : une véritable opportunité de relever de nouveaux défis au sein d’une FinTech à taille humaine, évoluant dans un cadre réglementaire en perpétuelle évolution.

Rattaché(e) au VP AML au sein du Département Conformité et Risques, en tant que manager opérationnel KYC, vous superviserez le cadre de gestion KYC de Lemonway.

Les principales responsabilités :

  • Management d’une équipe : 5 collaborateurs à temps plein ainsi que des stagiaires/CDD

    • Superviser la productivité quotidienne de l’équipe pour s’assurer de la charge de travail et du respect des délais.

    • Superviser l’équipe externalisée et gérer la relation avec les prestataires.

    • Veiller à ce que les processus de collecte et d’analyse des documents et informations, à l’onboarding et tout au long du cycle de vie des clients, soient conformes, efficaces et réalisés avec qualité. 

    • Coordonner des revues de qualité pour s'assurer que les membres de l'équipe effectuent correctement leurs missions et escalader les problèmes identifiés.

    • Formation continue des collaborateurs : fournir des feedbacks constructifs, des évaluations, des coachings et des formations

    • Réaliser des revues périodiques de qualité KYC et accompagner vos équipes sur les dossiers les plus complexes.

  • Conseil interne : Vous serez également en charge de conseiller les différentes parties prenantes internes et de veiller à répondre aux problématiques liées au KYC adressées par les clients.

    • Animer des formations sur les politiques KYC et évaluer leur efficacité.

    • Agir comme point de contact central pour l'équipe et point d’escalade pour les dossiers complexes.

  • Concevoir et superviser l’amélioration de notre cadre KYC

    • Mettre en œuvre et maintenir les politiques et procédures KYC.

    • Réaliser des évaluations des risques liés au cadre KYC et mettre en œuvre les recommandations des régulateurs, audits internes et contrôles internes.

    • Participer à la mise en place du cadre global de sécurité financière.


Expérience

  • Vous avez au moins 6 ans d’expérience et une spécialisation dans la lutte contre la criminalité financière et organisée.

  • Le management d’équipe fait une partie importante de votre expérience et vous appréciez l’opportunité de manager un équipe.

  • Vous avez un excellent niveau d’Anglais et de Français conversationnel.

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne compréhension du cadre réglementaire lié à la LCB-FT/Conformité/KYC.

  • Connaissance approfondie des différents cadres KYC.

  • Bonne connaissance des enjeux liés aux risques de sécurité financière.

  • Vous aimez les sujets d’IA et d’optimisation des processus.

    Compétences relationnelles

  • Vous êtes un(e) manager sensible et efficace, capable de tirer le meilleur de votre équipe.

  • Vous êtes un(e) vrai(e) joueur(se) d’équipe avec un sens profond de la collaboration, mais également à l’aise pour travailler de manière autonome.

  • Vous savez gérer votre temps efficacement et prioriser votre charge de travail dans un environnement rapide et compétitif.

  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos compétences organisationnelles et de gestion de projets.


NOS AVANTAGES

  • Bureaux au cœur du Sentier (Paris 2e)

  • Poste hybride (2j TT / semaine)

  • Carte Swile

  • Mutuelle Alan

  • Prise en charge à 50% du pass Navigo/Vélib

  • Accès à Gymlib

  • Prime vacances Syntec & RTT

title: Head of Regulatory  - CDI (F/H)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Lemonway
description_html:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé par l'ACPR, spécialisé dans les solutions de paiement pour les plateformes digitales, les marketplaces et les acteurs de la finance alternative.


Présent dans toute l'Europe, Lemonway accompagne des centaines de clients dans la gestion des flux financiers de leurs utilisateurs, avec une exigence forte en matière de conformité et de sécurité.

Au sein du département Compliance & Risk, la fonction Regulatory est un pilier stratégique : elle garantit la conformité de Lemonway vis-à-vis de ses obligations d'établissement de paiement agréé, assure la relation avec les régulateurs, et accompagne l'évolution du business dans un environnement réglementaire en mutation constante.


Le département Compliance & Risk est composé de 4 équipes : Regulatory, AML, Legal et Internal Control & Operational Risk. Dans cette organisation, le Head of Regulatory reporte directement au Chief Compliance & Risk Officer.


Vos missions

Relation avec les autorités de tutelle

  • Être l'interlocuteur principal de Lemonway auprès de l'ACPR et des superviseurs européens des pays dans lesquels Lemonway fournit ses services (passporting)

  • Préparer et coordonner certains reportings réglementaires périodiques français et européens

  • Piloter les réponses aux demandes d'information des autorités et assister la Chief Compliance & Risk Officer dans la gestion des inspections réglementaires

Maintien et évolution de l'agrément PSP

  • Superviser le respect permanent des conditions d'agrément : fonds propres, cantonnement des fonds clients, gouvernance

  • Instruire les dossiers d’extension ou de nouvel agrément liés au développement de nouveaux services ou à l'expansion géographique

  • Gérer les procédures de passeporting vers de nouveaux États membres de l'UE

Conformité réglementaire produit & business

  • Analyser la conformité réglementaire des nouvelles plateformes clientes ainsi que celle des nouveaux projets des clients existants

  • Être le point de contact des équipes commerciales afin d’apporter un conseil opérationnel sur les contraintes réglementaires liées à certains types de clients, secteurs ou marchands

  • Intégrer la dimension réglementaire dès la phase de conception des nouveaux produits et services

  • Garantir la conformité de l’entreprise au RGPD

  • Rédiger, maintenir et actualiser les politiques et procédures réglementaires internes

Veille et analyse réglementaire

  • Assurer une veille proactive sur l'évolution des textes réglementaires applicables à Lemonway en tant que PSP ainsi qu’à ses plateformes clientes, en France et en Europe (DSP3, AMLR, ECSPR, GDPR, IA Act, DORA, virements instantanés, etc.)

  • Analyser les impacts opérationnels et business des nouvelles réglementations et formuler des recommandations claires aux équipes concernées (Produit, Tech, Commercial, Finance)

Management & développement de l'équipe

  • Manager et faire monter en compétences le/la Regulatory Officer en poste

  • Structurer et animer la fonction Regulatory avec des processus clairs et scalables


Formation

  • Bac +5 en droit des affaires, droit bancaire et financier, ou équivalent

  • CAPA (avocat) ou formation en conformité réglementaire

Expérience

  • > 8 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de conseil ou de conformité réglementaire dans l'univers des services de paiement, de la FinTech ou de la banque

  • Une première expérience managériale ou de coordination d'équipe

Compétences

  • Maîtrise approfondie de la réglementation relative à l’encaissement pour compte de tiers et aux services de paiement (DSP2/DSP3, agrément ACPR, règles prudentielles)

  • Bonne connaissance des sujets émergents : ECSP, MiCA, DORA, IA Act, open banking, virements instantanés et VoP, etc.

title: Head of Internal Control, Operational Risk - CDI (F/H)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Lemonway
description_html:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement européen agréé, qui accompagne les marketplaces et les plateformes de crowdfunding dans plus de 29 pays.

Nous fournissons des services de paiement sécurisés, conformes et évolutifs pour la nouvelle économie, notamment des services de KYC, de traitement des paiements, de détection de la fraude, de ségrégation des fonds et de gestion des comptes. Notre expertise technologique et réglementaire permet à nos clients de développer leur activité tout en respectant les standards les plus exigeants en matière de conformité et de sécurité.

Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs, Lemonway est une entreprise dynamique et internationale, au cœur de l’économie numérique. Nous combinons l’agilité d’une scale-up avec les exigences et les responsabilités d’un établissement financier réglementé.


Le poste

Rattaché(e) a notre Chief Compliance & Risk Officer, vous prenez en charge les activités de contrôle interne, de gestion des risques opérationnels et de gouvernance de Lemonway.

Vous veillez à ce que le profil de risque de l’entreprise soit correctement identifié, évalué, suivi et communiqué, tout en contribuant au renforcement de son environnement de contrôle et de sa culture du risque.

Vous managez une équipe de deux personnes et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le CEO, la Direction générale, les fonctions de contrôle et les équipes opérationnelles. En tant que véritable business partner, vous accompagnez l’entreprise dans ses prises de décision, tout en vous assurant que ses activités restent conformes aux exigences réglementaires applicables, aux politiques internes et à l’appétit au risque défini.

Il s’agit d’un poste stratégique et opérationnel, particulièrement adapté à une personne qui apprécie de construire et d’améliorer des dispositifs dans un environnement international, en forte évolution et réglementé.

Les principales responsabilités :

Contrôle interne et contrôle permanent

  • Piloter et améliorer en continu le dispositif de contrôle interne de niveaux 1 et 2.

  • Définir, maintenir et mettre en œuvre le plan annuel de contrôle permanent.

  • Veiller à ce que les contrôles soient correctement conçus, documentés, réalisés et justifiés.

  • Développer les indicateurs de contrôle pertinents et les reportings destinés à la Direction et aux instances de gouvernance.

  • Identifier les faiblesses du dispositif de contrôle, évaluer leur impact et coordonner les actions correctives.

  • Promouvoir une culture forte du contrôle et de la gestion des risques dans l’ensemble de l’organisation.

  • Contribuer à la mise en place et à l’optimisation des outils et processus de type GRC.

Risques opérationnels et gestion des risques

  • Piloter le dispositif de gestion des risques opérationnels, notamment l’identification, l’évaluation et le suivi des risques.

  • Coordonner la préparation et la mise à jour régulière des cartographies des risques de l’entreprise.

  • Organiser et maintenir le Risk Appetite Framework, ainsi que le suivi des indicateurs d’appétit au risque.

  • Piloter le processus de gestion et de reporting des incidents, en veillant à ce que les incidents soient enregistrés, analysés et suivis de manière appropriée.

  • Suivre les risques opérationnels, non financiers et émergents, notamment les risques liés à la technologie, à la cybersécurité, à la fraude, à l’externalisation et aux processus métiers.

  • Préparer des reportings risques clairs et exploitables à destination de la Direction générale et des instances de gouvernance concernées.

Gouvernance et comités

  • Préparer, coordonner et animer le Comité des risques trimestriel.

  • Accompagner le Chief Compliance & Risk Officer et la Direction générale dans leurs prises de décision liées aux risques.

  • Préparer les supports de gouvernance, tableaux de bord et présentations offrant une vision claire de l’environnement de risques et de contrôle de l’entreprise.

  • Coordonner la définition et la mise à jour des rôles et responsabilités, notamment au travers des matrices RACI.

  • Contribuer aux processus de reporting réglementaire et interne, notamment au rapport annuel sur le contrôle interne, ainsi qu’aux autres reportings réglementaires applicables.

Audits et contrôles réglementaires

  • Coordonner les audits externes, réglementaires et internes portant sur le contrôle interne, les risques opérationnels et la gouvernance.

  • Être le point de contact principal des auditeurs et des autorités compétentes sur les sujets de contrôle interne.

  • Gérer les demandes d’audit, la collecte des éléments justificatifs, le suivi des constats et les actions associées.

  • Coordonner la préparation et la mise en œuvre des plans d’actions correctifs et préventifs.

  • Suivre l’avancement des plans de remédiation et présenter les actions à risque élevé ou en retard aux instances de gouvernance appropriées.

  • Coordonner le programme de contrôle périodique et suivre sa mise en œuvre conformément au plan d’audit défini.

Externalisation, continuité d’activité et résilience opérationnelle

  • Garantir la robustesse et la bonne exécution du dispositif PSEE.

  • Contribuer au pilotage des activités externalisées et des prestataires tiers, conformément aux exigences réglementaires applicables.

  • Piloter les activités de continuité d’activité et de résilience opérationnelle de l’entreprise.

  • Maintenir et tester régulièrement les plans de continuité d’activité.

  • Participer aux exercices et aux réunions de gestion de crise lorsque cela est nécessaire.

  • Identifier les opportunités permettant de renforcer la résilience de Lemonway et sa capacité à maintenir ses activités critiques en cas de perturbation.

Politiques, procédures et formation

  • Évaluer les besoins de création ou de mise à jour des politiques, procédures, formulaires et documents de contrôle.

  • Coordonner la rédaction, la revue et la mise en œuvre des procédures de contrôle interne et de gestion des risques.

  • Concevoir ou contribuer à la création de supports de formation et de sensibilisation.

  • Veiller à ce que la documentation soit claire, opérationnelle, à jour et alignée avec le modèle de fonctionnement de l’entreprise.


Expérience

  • Vous disposez d’au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans le contrôle interne, les risques opérationnels, l’ERM, l’audit, la conformité ou un domaine proche.

  • Vous avez évolué dans un environnement réglementé, idéalement dans le secteur du paiement ou en fintech.

  • Vous avez déjà encadré une équipe et travaillé sur la structuration ou la transformation d’un dispositif de gestion des risques et de contrôle interne.

Compétences recherchées

  • Solide connaissance des dispositifs de contrôle interne et de gestion des risques opérationnels.

  • Bonne compréhension de l’environnement réglementaire français et européen, notamment des attentes de l’ACPR, des orientations de l’EBA, des exigences LCB-FT et de la DSP2.

  • Expérience du fonctionnement d’instances de gouvernance et de la préparation de reportings destinés à la Direction générale.

  • Maîtrise des environnements de transformation, de croissance ou de scale-up.

  • Expérience de la mise en place ou de l’évolution d’outils GRC.

  • Très bon niveau de français et d’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

  • La connaissance de l’allemand ou d’une autre langue européenne constitue un atout.

Qualités personnelles

  • Leadership affirmé et bonnes compétences managériales.

  • Esprit structuré, rigoureux et grande capacité d’organisation.

  • Autonomie, tout en appréciant le travail collaboratif.

  • Approche pragmatique, orientée solutions et résultats.

  • Solides capacités d’analyse et grande attention aux détails.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes.

  • Capacité à challenger de manière constructive et à convaincre des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux.

  • Carte Swile

  • Mutuelle Alan

description_html:
Lemonway is a licensed payment institution, at the heart of the new European economy.

We secure payments for crowdfunding platforms, collaborative economy platforms, marketplaces, and e-merchants, with a strong commitment against fraud and to the protection of funds.

Regulated by the ACPR and holding a European passport in 29 countries, Lemonway is headquartered in Paris and brings together 150 multicultural and dedicated Lemonheroes.

More than 400 marketplaces trust us. We manage 1.4 million user wallets and have raised €50M from Breega, SpeedInvest, and Toscafund.

Profitable for four years and growing at +25% in 2025, Lemonway aims to remain among the leaders in European payments through healthy and sustainable growth.

The Position

As a member of the Account Management team, your responsibilities will include the following:

 

  • Client Portfolio Management : Manage, retain, and grow accounts based in France and Europe. Your first objective is to make our customers stay through continued satisfaction of our services.

  • Business Development : Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities with existing clients. Helping our customers think out of the box to maximize their sales operations and therefore boost the strength of Lemonway’s value proposition.

  • Client Relations: Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic clients, coordinate with other teams, ensure your customer portfolio overall satisfaction and quickly resolve any issues that arise in short delays.

  • Analysis and Reporting: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), prepare regular reports, and suggest areas for improvement. Update information and forecasts in Salesforce.

  • Internal Collaboration: Work closely with the product, support, and compliance teams to deliver the best possible customer experience.


Your experience

  • You have < 3 years of experience as Account Manager or Account Executive.

  • You have at least one confirmed experience in either the payments industry or in fintech.

  • You have previously worked with large B2B clients in an international context.

  • You have previously managed large portfollio of merchants (SMB).

Your skills

  • You have excellent negotiation, project management, and communication skills.

  • Customer- and solution-oriented, you are eager to constantly learn and improve our solution in collaboration with other internal teams.

  • You are bilignual French - English and are fluent in either Spanish or Italian.

Why join us ?

  • Grow your career in Account Management and FinTech through the experience of managing a complex and crucial solution for our partners. The value of this experience will be undeniable for your future.

  • Our AM team is composed of highly talented and experienced individuals who work together (sharing advice, feedback, ideas) to ensure overall healthy retention rates. It is a team that will help you grow.

  • Work with a manager who will be there for you. Whether you need guidance, advice, or simply someone to talk to, Arthur will place his expertise and management skills to help you enhance your skills and potential.

  • Lemonway’s feedback structure is designed to ensure your growth through your experience with us.

Other benefits :

  • Offices in the heart of Sentier (Paris 2nd arrondissement)

  • Hybrid position (2 days remote working / week)

  • Swile card

  • Alan health insurance

  • 50% coverage of Navigo/Vélib pass

  • Access to Gymlib

  • Syntec holiday bonus & RTT (additional days off)

Authority baut ein Expertennetzwerk auf, um wichtige Entwicklungen in der globalen Rechenzentrumsbranche zu verstehen und vorherzusagen.

  • Informationen zu Projekten, Betreibern, Investoren und Großkunden
  • Prüfung von Prognosen und Erklärung relevanter lokaler Signale

  • Cloud-, KI- und Hochleistungsrecheninfrastruktur

About the role

Authority is building an expert intelligence network to understand and forecast important developments across the global data-centre industry.

We are looking for an experienced data-centre professional who is currently active in the the United Kingdom market and has up-to-date knowledge of local conditions.

Relevant areas of expertise

  • Colocation and hyperscale operations

  • Power procurement and grid connections

Ready to move fast, build bold, and ship AI from day one? Join the team building the content engine for AI search visibility and see your work go live in days, not months.

Send us your interest, CV, and a link to your GitHub or recent projects, or contact Simon Wilhelm directly.

Our hiring process is simple: 15-min intro call → Deep dive & challenge → Meet the team → Offer.

title: Area Director, London
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Neko Health
description_html:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

As the London Area Director, you will be accountable for bringing Neko Health’s operating model, culture, and member first standards to life across an existing portfolio of clinics in London.

This role sits at the intersection of leadership, execution, and local adaptation, ensuring that global ways of working translate into consistently high quality experiences on the ground, while continuing to mature and evolve as we scale.

Reporting to the Country Leader, UK, you will own regional performance end to end, from new site readiness through sustained multi-site operations. You will act as the cultural and operational anchor for Neko Health in London, setting expectations, building capability, and reinforcing how clinics lead, operate, and serve members.

 

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Continue embedding Neko Health’s operating model across the London clinics, focusing on strong leadership behaviours, cultural norms, and consistent execution rather than net-new process design. Ensure global standards are understood, embraced and brought to life in day-to-day clinic operations.

  • Lead the successful local adoption of existing playbooks and standards, tailoring them thoughtfully to local regulations, team dynamics, and member expectations while preserving the integrity of Neko’s global member experience.

  • Create strong clinic level leadership capability by coaching managers and clinical leads on how to translate standards into practice: setting clear expectations, reinforcing accountability, and role modelling a member first mindset.

  • Establish clear performance rhythms (metrics, reviews, feedback loops) that reinforce behaviours, surface issues early, and continuously improve both team effectiveness and the member experience.

  • Partner closely with the Country Leader, UK and central teams to ensure the global operating model works in practice locally, identifying where light adaptation is required and driving disciplined, high quality implementation at scale.

Clinic & Member Experience

  • Ensure each clinic consistently delivers a seamless, premium member experience aligned with Neko Health's service standards and brand promise.

  • Lead regional initiatives to elevate service quality based on member feedback, NPS insights, and frontline observations, iterating playbooks in real time as you learn.

  • Foster a hospitality-driven culture where empathy, professionalism, and precision define every member interaction, and where that culture is embedded through training, not just expectation.

  • Oversee the physical and experiential standards of all clinics, ensuring consistency in ambiance, cleanliness, and overall presentation across a growing portfolio.

Medical Quality & Compliance

  • Partner with Clinic Leads and Quality team to build and uphold Neko's clinical quality standards in the UK context, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements from the ground up.

  • Drive continuous improvement in medical delivery and inspection readiness across all sites, establishing audit-ready documentation and escalation protocols.

  • Serve as the bridge between clinic operations and the Medical Excellence team, ensuring best practices are embedded regionally through structured processes rather than informal norms.

Operational & Financial Performance

  • Own regional operational KPIs and full P&L accountability, and continue building the financial frameworks alongside the clinics themselves.

  • Oversee workforce planning and staffing models in collaboration with central teams, building hiring profiles, ramp plans, and scheduling logic suited to London’s demand patterns.

  • Contribute to regional business strategy, including network optimisation, market expansion planning, and new clinic launches.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Recruit, onboard, lead, and coach a team of Clinic Leads and Lead Operators across all assigned clinics.

  • Build a strong culture of accountability, communication, and collaboration across distributed teams from day one, establishing the norms and rituals that will define how the London team works.

  • Act as the primary regional liaison between clinic teams and central functions, including Customer Support, Facilities, Workforce Planning, People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Demand Planning.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in a senior operational leadership role (Area Director, Regional Director, District Leader, General Manager or equivalent) within a premium, consumer facing, multi-site environment such as premium healthcare adjacent, wellness, fitness or technology enabled services with physical operations/stores.

  • Demonstrated success implementing and embedding established operating models, standards, and playbooks across multiple locations, driving adoption through leadership, coaching, and accountability rather than documentation alone.

  • Strong track record leading clinic level or site level leaders, with the ability to build capability, reinforce culture, and translate standards into consistent day to day execution.

  • Proven financial and operational acumen, including ownership of regional KPIs, budgets, and P&L performance in a scaling context.

  • Ability to balance strategic perspective with hands on execution, particularly during periods of growth, new site openings, and organisational change.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence operating in a matrixed, fast moving organisation across central and regional teams.

  • Comfort leading through ambiguity and change, with a bias toward action, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.

title: Staff Product Manager: Agentic Discovery
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Constructor
description_html:
Staff Product Manager, Agentic Discovery

About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary We're looking for a systems-minded, AI-native Staff Product Manager to help lead the next chapter of Constructor: Agentic Discovery. As commerce shifts toward agentic experiences, we're investing heavily in a portfolio of AI-powered surfaces — our AI Shopping Assistant, Product Insights Agent, Prism recommendations, and more to come — that change how shoppers discover products and how businesses run discovery.

This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. You'll own two things at once: helping our agentic experiences scale from promising experiments into a repeatable, reliable engine, and giving the business teams who depend on them the same transparency and control over agentic experiences that they have today over traditional search.

You'll start by owning the business tooling and dashboards for agentic discovery — the experiences that let business teams see what our agents are doing, why, and to what effect, so they can execute faster and steer with confidence. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Agentic Discovery chapter: the on-site agentic experiences, the offsite/agentic surfaces, the integrations that connect them, and the agentic tooling underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Agentic discovery at Constructor is fundamentally an AI and machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes it. You'll partner closely with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market to turn new agentic capabilities into experiences that ship, prove value, and stay under our customers' control — and serve as the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams behind one coherent vision for agentic discovery.

If you're excited about defining a brand-new category, being held to real usage and business outcomes, and giving businesses control over the AI experiences shaping their storefronts, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in usage and business outcomes — conversion, revenue, engagement — across Constructor's agentic experiences.

  • Give businesses transparency and control. Build the dashboards and tooling that let business teams see what agentic experiences are doing, understand why, and steer them — closing the gap to the control they have in traditional search.

  • Scale experimentation. Turn one-off agentic experiments into a repeatable, scalable way to launch, measure, and improve new agentic interfaces — cutting time-to-launch.

  • Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for Agentic Discovery — where we're heading and why — tie it to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

  • Lead the business-tooling and dashboard experience first. Own its strategy and roadmap, and make agentic behavior and impact visible and actionable for business users.

     

  • Orchestrate across surfaces. Unite on-site agentic experiences, offsite/agentic surfaces, and integrations behind one definition of agentic discovery success, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

     

  • Turn AI capability into shipped experiences. Partner with ML and engineering to take agentic and LLM-powered experiences from idea to production, balancing quality, latency, cost, and reliability.

     

  • Make success measurable. Define and instrument the metrics — go-live velocity, usage, engagement, business outcomes — that tell us whether agentic discovery is working.

     

  • Keep it trustworthy. Treat explainability, control, and guardrails as first-class requirements so customers trust and adopt agentic experiences.

     

  • Grow the mandate. Expand from business tooling into chapter-wide leadership across the full agentic portfolio and the integrations beneath it.

What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will have:

  • Shipped a dashboard and tooling experience that gives business teams real transparency into and control over Constructor's agentic experiences, adopted by internal teams and customers.

  • Driven measurable lift in the usage and business impact (conversion, revenue) of agentic experiences across multiple customers.

  • Stood up a repeatable process for launching and experimenting with new agentic interfaces, measurably shortening time-to-launch.

  • Defined the core metrics for agentic discovery and made them visible in one place.

  • Begun uniting the on-site, offsite, and integrations teams behind one coherent direction for the chapter.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in AI/ML, agentic, search, or discovery products, including time operating at a senior or staff level.

  • A track record of moving business metrics at scale — usage, conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams.

  • Experience building for business users/operators (merchandisers, category managers, or similar) — especially the tooling, dashboards, and controls they rely on.

  • Strong AI/ML/LLM product depth — understands how agentic and LLM-powered experiences work and can reason about their tradeoffs (quality, latency, cost, reliability).

  • Comfort with zero-to-one ambiguity and with scaling — able to experiment on brand-new interfaces and to build the repeatable process that turns them into a portfolio.

  • A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every experience back to usage and business outcomes.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of success, working shoulder-to-shoulder with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market.

  • A strong instinct for trust — treating transparency, control, and guardrails as core to whether agentic experiences succeed.

  • Comfort setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart.

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options.

  • Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee).

  • Fully remote team — choose where you live.

  • Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office.

  • Apple laptops provided for new employees.

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

  • Parental leave for qualified employees.

  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

This position is fully remote — Constructor.io is a remote-first company.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor At Constructor.io, we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or affiliation in any other protected group.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

title: Talent Scout / Recruiter (m/w/d) | 100 % Remote
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Claudia Buhl
description_html:
Die besten Talente findet man nicht. Man erkennt sie.

Wenn du Potenziale erkennst, gerne mit Menschen kommunizierst und Freude daran hast, Talente und Unternehmen erfolgreich zusammenzubringen, dann suchen wir genau dich.

Bevor du weiterliest, möchten wir dir unnötigen Aufwand ersparen:
Für diese Position ist ein Wohnsitz oder Zweitwohnsitz in Deutschland zwingend erforderlich. Nur wenn diese Voraussetzung erfüllt ist, ist eine Bewerbung möglich.

Für unseren Klienten T. Eilers & Partner suchen wir Verstärkung im Recruiting.

T.Eilers & Partner ist spezialisiert auf die strategische Beratung von Unternehmern mit dem Ziel, Einnahmen und Ausgaben nachhaltig zu optimieren. Der Fokus liegt auf kleinen und mittelständischen Unternehmen sowie deren privaten Haushalten. Struktur, Verlässlichkeit und Professionalität prägen die tägliche Zusammenarbeit – ebenso wie der Anspruch, Menschen individuell, transparent und auf Augenhöhe zu begleiten.

Um dieses Wachstum auch künftig erfolgreich fortzusetzen, suchen wir Menschen, die nicht nur Bewerbungen verwalten, sondern Talente erkennen und die richtigen Persönlichkeiten für unser Team gewinnen möchten.

Aufgaben

Du besetzt nicht einfach offene Stellen – du gewinnst die Menschen, die unser Unternehmen morgen mitgestalten.

Mit deinem Gespür für Potenziale, deiner Kommunikationsstärke und deiner strukturierten Arbeitsweise begleitest du den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess – von der ersten Stellenausschreibung bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Passende Talente für unsere offenen Positionen finden und erfolgreich für unser Unternehmen gewinnen
  • Kreative Stellenanzeigen entwickeln und auf den passenden Plattformen veröffentlichen
  • Bewerbungen sichten, Potenziale erkennen und eine qualifizierte Vorauswahl (Pre-Screening) treffen
  • Telefonische und digitale Kennenlern- und Vorstellungsgespräche führen
  • Unser Personalmarketing, die Personalentwicklung sowie das Social-Media-Recruiting aktiv mitgestalten und kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln

Qualifikation

Was uns wichtig ist

Für diese Position wünschen wir uns eine Persönlichkeit, die folgende Eigenschaften mitbringt:

  • Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und kommunizierst offen, wertschätzend und professionell.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick.
  • Du erkennst Potenziale und hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen.
  • Du bist offen für digitale Tools, moderne Arbeitsweisen und neue Ideen.
  • Du verfügst über einen Wohnsitz oder Zweitwohnsitz in Deutschland.
  • Du verfügst über eine stabile Internetverbindung (mindestens 30 Mbit).

Benefits

Wir bieten dir ein modernes, digitales Arbeitsumfeld mit flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen und der Möglichkeit, 100 % remote zu arbeiten (Wohnsitz oder Zweitwohnsitz in Deutschland erforderlich).

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung – Einstieg bereits ab ca. 8 bis 15 Stunden pro Woche möglich
  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung mit attraktiven Entwicklungs- und Verdienstmöglichkeiten Beispielhafte Einkommensspanne: ca. 530 € bis 1.650 € monatlich, je nach Qualifikation sowie abhängig von Einsatz, Aktivität und Lernfortschritt
  • Einsatz in Teilzeit, Vollzeit oder auf selbstständiger Basis möglich
  • Moderne digitale Tools, strukturierte Prozesse und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung in den Bereichen Recruiting, Kommunikation und Organisation

Vielleicht findest du schon morgen den Menschen, der unser Unternehmen entscheidend voranbringt.

Wenn dich dieser Gedanke begeistert, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Deine Bewerbung wird im Auftrag von T. Eilers & Partner entgegengenommen und direkt weitergeleitet.

Claudia Meyer
Pesonalverantwortliche

title: Quality Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at shopware AG
description_html:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das Unternehmen weltweit dabei unterstützt, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu wachsen. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Händlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Als Quality Engineering Lead führst und entwickelst du ein Team von Quality Engineers und trägst dazu bei, die Zuverlässigkeit der Commerce-Plattform von Shopware zu verbessern. Du verbindest Mitarbeiterführung mit praktischer Arbeit in den Bereichen Testing und Automatisierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering- und Produktteams zusammen, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und die Entwicklung sowie Veröffentlichung unserer Software kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Du übersetzt Unternehmensziele und Produktprioritäten in eine Quality-Engineering-Roadmap mit klaren und messbaren Verbesserungszielen. Du setzt Prioritäten, delegierst Aufgaben und stellst dich direkt komplexen Herausforderungen im Testing.


  • Führe, unterstütze und entwickle das Team durch regelmäßiges Feedback, Mitarbeitergespräche und individuelle Karriereentwicklung. Unterstütze außerdem bei der Einstellung und beim Onboarding.

  • Definiere gemeinsam mit den Engineering-Kolleg:innen die Teststrategie und Qualitätsstandards für die Produktteams. Priorisiere und verteile Quality-Engineering-Aufgaben entsprechend den Produktrisiken, Roadmap-Zielen und Teamkapazitäten.

  • Arbeite aktiv an Testdesign, Testautomatisierung und explorativem Testing mit. Unterstütze bei der Analyse komplexer Fehler und validiere Änderungen, die mehrere Produktbereiche betreffen.

  • Unterstütze Quality Engineers, Entwickler:innen und Product Manager teamübergreifend bei der Umsetzung der Teststrategie und dabei, Qualität frühzeitig in Planung und Entwicklung zu berücksichtigen.

  • Verbessere Testwerkzeuge und -praktiken, einschließlich des verantwortungsvollen Einsatzes KI-gestützter Tests. Nutze Kundenprobleme, Fehler und die Zuverlässigkeit von Tests, um Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren.

  • Unterstütze Produkt-Releases, indem du Testergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken und eine klare Qualitätsempfehlung an die für den Release koordinierenden Kolleg:innen kommunizierst.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Erfahrung in der Führung eines technischen Teams, einschließlich Coaching, Performance-Gesprächen und individueller Weiterentwicklung.

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Softwaretesting, in der Entwicklung von Teststrategien und in der Testautomatisierung, einschließlich Ansätzen wie End-to-End-, API-, Integrations- oder Komponententests.

  • Erfahrung in der Definition und Präsentation von Qualitätsmetriken sowie darin, diese gemeinsam mit Testergebnissen und Risikobewertungen zu nutzen, um Lücken zu erkennen und Entscheidungen zu unterstützen.

  • Die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, Aufgaben zu delegieren und effektiv mit Kolleg:innen aus den Bereichen Engineering und Produkt zusammenzuarbeiten.

  • Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englischkenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte und Abwägungen verständlich zu erklären. Deutschkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich.

Hilfreich, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich

Erfahrung im E-Commerce, mit Open-Source-Software, Cloud-Anwendungen, Upgrades und Migrationen sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung und Testautomatisierung ist von Vorteil. Vorkenntnisse in Shopware sind nicht erforderlich.

Wir begrüßen vielfältige Karrierewege und Perspektiven. Du musst nicht in allen genannten Bereichen Erfahrung haben, um dich zu bewerben. Erzähle uns, wie dich dein bisheriger Werdegang darauf vorbereitet hat, ein Team zu führen und die Softwarequalität zu verbessern.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!
Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Schröer und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier.

title: Campaign Manager (m|w|d) - Elternzeitvertretung
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at idealo internet GmbH
description_html:
In der Rolle als Campaign Manager (m|w|d), verantwortest du die operative Steuerung und Optimierung von Retail Media-Kampagnen für unsere Werbekunden. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Werbekampagnen erfolgreich umgesetzt, datenbasiert optimiert und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden – mit dem Ziel, sowohl den kommerziellen Erfolg als auch eine positive User Experience zu gewährleisten. 

 Als Teil des Retail Media Onsite Teams arbeitest du eng mit externen Partnern – darunter Brands, Shops und Agenturen – sowie bereichsübergreifend mit Sales, Product, Tech und Data zusammen. In dieser Schnittstellenfunktion leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur strategischen Weiterentwicklung und erfolgreichen Skalierung unseres Sponsored-Ads-Portfolios. 

Du übersetzt die strategische Ausrichtung in operative Exzellenz und hilfst dabei, ein leistungsstarkes Retail-Media-Setup aufzubauen. 

Die Stelle ist für 12 Monate als Elternzeitvertretung befristet.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Operative Steuerung und Optimierung von Onsite-Werbekampagnen (z. B. Sponsored Product Ads oder individuelle Branding-Formaten). 

  • Monitoring und kontinuierliche Verbesserung relevanter KPIs. 

  • Kampagnen-Setup, Qualitätssicherung und Reporting im Austausch mit den jeweiligen Werbekunden (Markenhersteller, Agenturen und Händler). 

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales bei Kampagnenplanung, -aussteuerung und Performance-Feedback. 

  • Analyse von Performance-Daten und Ableitung konkreter Optimierungsmaßnahmen. 

  • Unterstützung bei der Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Pricing-Logiken sowie des Inventarmanagements in enger Abstimmung mit deiner Führungskraft, dem Expert Lead Retail Media. 

  • Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, Standards und Reporting-Strukturen im Onsite-Bereich. 

  • Identifikation von Optimierungs- und Upselling-Potenzialen gemeinsam mit dem Sales-Team.


Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Bereich Digital Advertising, Retail Media oder Performance Marketing.  

  • Fundierte Hands-on-Erfahrung im Kampagnenmanagement und in der Performance-Optimierung. 

  • Gutes Verständnis für Retail-Media-KPIs, Auktionslogiken und Inventarsteuerung. 

  • Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise. 

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Data). 

  • Strukturierte, präzise und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, sowie ein hohes Maß an Ownership und Lösungsorientierung. 

  • Du behältst eine Hands-on-, lösungs- und umsetzungsorientierte Haltung, treibst Initiativen voran, räumst Hindernisse aus dem Weg und lieferst Ergebnisse – auch in unklaren Situationen.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Kriterien? Keine Sorge, wir suchen Mitarbeiter:innen, die uns mit ihrer Persönlichkeit überzeugen und motiviert sind, gemeinsam mit ihrem Team alles zu geben!

Bei idealo erwartet dich

  • Du willst dich weiterbilden? Wir nehmen deine persönlichen Entwicklungsziele ernst und bieten dir neben unserem idealo Learning Hub, eLearning Angeboten (z.B. Udemy), Coachings & Mediation auch die Möglichkeit individuell von unserem Weiterbildungsbudget zu profitieren.

  • Und was kann das Büro? Unser Büro, im Herzen Berlins, bietet neben dem “Standard-Kicker” auch hervorragendes kostenfreies Mittagessen, sowie kostenfreien Kaffee, Limonade und Feierabend-Bier. Dabei kannst du auf unserer wunderschönen Dachterrasse mit Kolleg:innen aus unserer Unternehmensgruppe netzwerken.

  • Du wünschst dir Unterstützung auch außerhalb der Arbeit? Eine kostenlose Beratung, sowie Unterstützung in allen Lebenslagen (beruflich, privat, familiär, gesundheitlich etc.) bieten wir in Zusammenarbeit mit dem pme-Familienservice.

  • Du willst auch mobil sein? Mit Job-Bike oder Deutschlandticket kein Problem – und das ist auch noch umweltfreundlich!

  • Du möchtest dich fit halten? Hierzu bieten wir dir viele unterschiedliche Fitness- und Sportmöglichkeiten wie zum Beispiel eine Urban Sports oder Gympass Mitgliedschaft für deine ganz persönlichen Bedürfnisse an.

  • Und was gibt es noch? Selbstverständlich müssen Erfolge gefeiert werden! Neben Team-Events erwarten dich auch große Company-Events, bei denen wir keine Kosten und Mühen scheuen.

LI-MW

title: Working Student – Release Support and Automation
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Snke
description_html:
What you'll do

Snke Viewing is our team building a medical imaging viewer, part of Snke's suite of software solutions that let clinicians and researchers work with complex imaging and clinical data. Join our Munich team and help keep Snke Viewing reliable and release-ready — from researching incident and safety data to testing new versions and looking after the environments they run in.

This is a working student position applicable for applicants currently enrolled at an university. The position is for up to 20 hours per week with flexibility during exam periods. Please note that this is an onsite position based in Munich, and regular presence at our Munich office is required.

  • Monitor and track Snake Viewing-related incidents across public and internal sources (e.g. BfArM, MAUDE, CID) using both manual research and automated routines
  • Support software development and release activities by testing new features, bug fixes, and release candidates
  • Help maintain and continuously improve the testing environment, ensuring its stability and readiness for validation activities
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring tasks related to incident monitoring, testing, and release management, and contribute to implementing these solutions
  • Support project managers with day-to-day project coordination and operational tasks
  • Work alongside the development team throughout the full development cycle from early concepts and implementation to final testing and release


What we're looking for

  • Studies in computer science, health informatics, medical technology, lifesciencesor a related field
  • (Bio)medical imaging background
  • Strong interest in medical imaging anddata processing
  • Interest in medical device safety/vigilance data and a structured, detail-oriented approach to researching and documenting findings
  • First experience with, or strong interest in, software testing/QA concepts and release or deployment processes
  • Basic programming/scripting skills and enthusiasm for automating recurring tasksworking with GitHub workflows
  • Structured and independent working style witha high levelof reliability
  • Good command of English in a professional environment; German is nice to have


Why Snke

  • A supportive, international team connected by shared values and a culture of trust
  • Meaningful responsibilities with a lasting impact on global healthtech, improving medical decisions and patient outcomes
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model within Germany
  • Parking garage and secure underground bike storage
  • Subsidized company restaurant and in-house café
  • Regular after-work, team, and company events
  • Centrally located, modern workspace with a 212 m² rooftop terrace

Ready to apply? We look forward to receiving your online application including your earliest possible start date.

description_html:
What you'll do

As a Senior Software Engineer, Support & Integration (C++), you will join the Snke Anatomy Applications team and help ensure that our Digital Patient Model services are reliably integrated and supported in customer environments. In this role, you will handle escalated technical issues and provide third-level support through analysis, root cause investigation, and collaboration with the engineering team. You will also support legacy products through technical analysis and contribute to development work whenever support demand allows.

  • Investigate and analyze customer-reported issues in production systems, integration setups, and internal environments.
  • Reproduce issues, identify root causes, and provide clear technical findings to the responsible engineering team.
  • Support customers with the integration of our services, APIs, and data flows.
  • Analyze issues in legacy products and support their continued operation.
  • Work with modern C++20 services and understand older C++ code bases for debugging and support purposes.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to internal teams and customers.
  • Contribute to development work when support priorities allow.


What we're looking for

We are looking for someone with several years of professional experience in C++ software engineering and technical support or integration roles. You should be able to investigate complex issues independently, communicate technical findings clearly, and work confidently with both modern and legacy code bases.

  • Several years of professional experience in C++ software engineering.
  • Experience in technical support, application support, integration support, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, especially when reproducing issues, analyzing logs, and identifying root causes.
  • Ability to work with both modern and older C++ code bases for debugging and support when necessary.
  • Experience with distributed backend systems and gRPC services using Protocol Buffers.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical findings clearly and concisely.
  • An independent, structured working style and the ability to drive investigations to a solid conclusion.
Nice-to-Have
  • Experience supporting healthcare or other regulated software products.
  • Familiarity with Git and scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, observability, logging, and monitoring.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Experience with DICOM or other medical data standards.


Why Snke

  • A supportive, international team connected by shared values and a culture of trust
  • Meaningful responsibilities with a lasting impact on global healthtech, improving medical decisions and patient outcomes

  • You thrive in a low-process, Kanban-driven environment where seniors self-organize, rotate weekly triage duties without micro-management, and prefer automating recurring requests over manually repeating them
  • Optional: You bring skills or interest in object-oriented design, data modeling/dbt, BigQuery architecture, orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Dagster), stream processing (Beam, Flink, Spark), or internal automation (n8n, AI triage bots).

title: Junior Data Engineer

description_html:
About the role

Data is undeniably one of the world's most valuable resources. However, it's futile if it's not in the right place or the right setup. We strive to place data where it's needed most and can be used to its fullest potential.


Become a valued member of our data integration team and start your journey building scalable data architectures and fast data pipelines for our multinational clients. Our use cases range from data warehouse and lakehouse architecture implementations over IoT and data streaming setups to sophisticated AI scenarios, in industries ranging from manufacturing, consumer products, and healthcare to banking and insurance, just to name a few.


Your responsibilities

  • You will support the team in designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines according to client business needs and embedding them end-to-end into the given data stack

  • On this role, you will assist in maintaining and optimizing data infrastructure required for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL/ELT) from a wide variety of data sources

  • As a junior Data Engineer, you will build, test, and deploy data artifacts on cloud platforms using modern version control best practices

  • You will collaborate with senior engineers to ensure data accuracy, integrity, privacy, security, and compliance by applying data quality assurance methods

  • Monitoring data pipeline performance and assisting in identifying opportunities for pipeline optimization

  • In this role, you will work closely together with both reeeliance and client staff as part of an agile project team


Our requirements

  • Solid foundational knowledge of data modeling concepts and modern data warehousing architectures

  • Proficiency in Python and strong SQL skills for querying and manipulating complex datasets

  • Hands-on experience with Git for version control and collaborative development

  • Practical exposure to or understanding of working within cloud environments (such as Azure or AWS)

  • Eagerness to learn new ETL/ELT tools, cloud technologies, and software engineering practices

  • Strong problem-solving attitude and an enthusiastic, proactive approach to learning

  • Ability to work both independently on delegated tasks and collaboratively within agile project teams

  • A university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience)

  • Articulate with impeccable verbal and written communication skills in German (C1 level) and English (B2 level). Strong & discerning listener


What we offer

  • Space to grow: Taking ownership in international projects while continuously expanding your skills

  • Mentorship and Onboarding: Structured introduction supported by dedicated mentor

  • Cutting-edge workspace: Work with the latest technology and modern equipment to drive innovative solutions

  • Long-term stability: A permanent employment in a family-oriented and people-focused company

  • Diverse & inclusive environment: Join a truly international environment and collaborate daily with teammates from over 15 different nationalities

  • Balance matters or work-life harmony: A work schedule designed to promote well-being and productivity

  • Team culture & connection: Social events and structured team-building days held in Berlin and Hamburg

  • Language courses: Learn, improve or practice your conversational skills on language platform Lingoda

  • Never stop learning: You’ll receive a dedicated budget to industry-leading platforms like Udemy and MasterClass to sharpen your technical expertise and leadership skills

  • …and many other Job perks (childcare subsidy, company pension scheme, job bike, etc…)

title: Infrastructure Engineer - Deployments (d/f/m)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Arculus
description_html:
Responsibilities

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for the reliable delivery and deployment of our software systems to customer environments. You will ensure that deployments are automated, resilient, and adaptable to diverse on-premise and hybrid infrastructures.
Operating at the intersection of infrastructure, software, and customer environments, you will play a key role in enabling smooth commissioning, stable operations, and continuous improvement of our deployment processes.

Your Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Own and execute end-to-end deployments across on-premise and hybrid environments, including software rollout, commissioning, and go-live support
  • Configure and validate infrastructure (compute, storage, clusters, networking, mTLS) to ensure production readiness
  • Troubleshoot and resolve deployment and infrastructure issues; support Customer Success team during escalations
  • Develop and maintain deployment automation, runbooks, and standardized procedures
  • Implement automated rollback, recovery workflows, and improve CI/CD-driven deployment processes
  • Monitor system health and capacity; manage lifecycle activities such as patching, upgrades, and maintenance
  • Implement and test backup and recovery strategies, ensuring compliance with recovery objectives
  • Coordinate with customer IT and internal teams on network, security, and hardware integration requirements
  • Document site-specific configurations and feed insights back to improve architecture, tooling, and deployment processes
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by optimizing workflows and supporting internal test environments


Qualifications

  • Strong experience with Linux systems administration and container runtimes (Docker, Docker Compose)
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating Kubernetes-based systems in production
  • Solid knowledge of networking (VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, OT/IT environments)
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and automation tools (Ansible, Terraform)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab) and version control (Git)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki)
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in complex environments
  • Experience with certificate management (PKI)


Nice to haves

  • Experience with air-gapped or restricted-network deployments
  • Familiarity with Helm and GitOps tools (e.g., ArgoCD, FluxCD)
  • Knowledge of industrial networks and OT/IT convergence
  • Experience with Debian/Linux packaging
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., RHCE, LPIC, CKA)


We offer

  • We are a diverse, global team of 100+ creative thinkers, algorithmic brains, makers, movers, and shakers.
  • Our approach comes from a continuous cycle: assemble, weld, code, test, deploy or delete, and repeat. That is how we deliver innovative solutions to tackle the biggest intralogistics challenges.
  • You will find our tech space nestled within the eastern region of Munich. It serves as a hub for our team's creativity and collaboration, featuring state-of-the-art meeting rooms, a fully-equipped electronics lab, and a spacious robotics testing area. Our team also enjoys a variety of social spaces, all within the modern infrastructure of the renowned Neue Balan campus.
  • We are more than just a workplace: we are a community. We encourage connection and affiliation through a range of activities: hiking trips, running events, ping pong tournaments, and quiz nights — there is something for everyone.
  • We also believe that work should be rewarding in more ways than just one. That is why we offer competitive salaries and benefits like EGYM Wellpass, language courses, Jobrad, and flexible working hours.
  • If you are moving to join our team, we provide relocation and visa support to help make the transition as smooth as possible.


Diversity and Inclusion

We are an equal opportunity employer and highly value diversity and inclusivity, which we see as strengths. While we are making progress, we are not yet where we want to be. Still, we believe in the power of a diverse workforce and welcome applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, national origins, sexual orientations, cultures, and educational backgrounds. Our goal is to create a work culture where everyone feels equally heard and included.

title: Senior Product Owner / Program Manager (m/f/d)

description_html:
What to expect

We're looking for a Senior Product & Program Manager who can turn complex digital products and transformation initiatives into tangible outcomes.

You combine product leadership, program management and consulting: connecting user needs, business goals, technology and organizational realities, while bringing structure to ambiguity and alignment across complex stakeholder environments.

You will work closely with Product Owners and senior stakeholders, steer multiple workstreams and help clients make better product, technology and transformation decisions. You won't just execute within an existing setup — you'll challenge assumptions, identify opportunities and help evolve products, processes and ways of working.


Your competencies

  • 5+ years in Product Management, Product Ownership, Program Management, Digital Consulting or a comparable role
  • Proven experience shipping digital products and leading complex initiatives
  • Strong cross-functional experience across product, design, technology and business
  • Strong understanding of agile product development and product leadership
  • Ability to connect user needs, business goals, technology and delivery realities
  • Experience owning scope, budget, delivery and commercial outcomes
  • Excellent senior stakeholder management, with the confidence to challenge and influence
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, complexity and organizational change
  • Genuine interest in AI and its practical impact on products and organizations
  • Experience in digital transformation, consulting or multi-workstream programs is a strong plus
  • Native German and fluent English


What You Can Look Forward To

  • Lead product ownership across complex, multi-workstream initiatives, connecting vision, priorities, delivery and business outcomes
  • Act as a senior counterpart to Product Owners and stakeholders across business, technology and design
  • Translate user and business needs into product strategies, roadmaps, priorities and decisions
  • Navigate complex stakeholder landscapes and create alignment across functions and organizational levels
  • Own and steer scope, budget, dependencies, risks and delivery
  • Bring structure to ambiguity, identify blockers and drive decisions and progress
  • Establish effective agile product routines and ways of working
  • Challenge existing approaches and act as a trusted advisor to clients
  • Identify and assess meaningful AI opportunities across products, processes and ways of working
  • Drive transformation and organizational change, connecting individual work-streams to the larger transformation agenda


We are looking forward to meet you

Freelancers are welcome to apply for this role as well.

title: Senior Operations Manager (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Alemi Zurich
description_html:
Your responsibilities

ALEMI is looking for a Senior Operations Manager to take end-to-end ownership of our operational backbone — from forecasting and production orders to inbound logistics, stock, and cost control. You'll be the person who keeps product moving reliably from our production partners to our warehouse and stores, while building the processes and KPI discipline that let us scale.

  • Forecasting & product launches — Own demand forecasting and order management with our production partners, and drive new products from setup through to launch-ready operational data in the relevant systems

  • Inbound logistics & stock — Plan cost-efficient, timely inbound transportation and manage stock levels across warehouse and our stores to hit availability targets and avoid out-of-stock situations

  • Process oversight & automation — Oversee core fulfillment, returns, and other after sale processes and continuously drive automation and quality improvements

  • Cost management & KPI reporting — Monitor logistics costs against plan, validate invoices, and own the operations KPI reporting (GetKLAR)

  • Strategic partnership — Act as the key operational partner across Product, Customer Service, Finance, and external partners, continuously improving warehouse and logistics processes

  • Project management — Lead cross-team projects to continuously improve the operations set-up

  • Packaging — Ensure reliable packaging material supply across our partners and locations


Your profile

  • Several years of experience in operations, supply chain, or logistics management, ideally in fashion, e-commerce, or retail

  • Track record of owning a function end-to-end, incl. inventory planning, demand forecasting, and cost/KPI frameworks

  • Strong affinity for AI and automation tools, with a genuine drive to make processes more efficient

  • Vision and clear understanding of what a state of the art operations set-up and process looks like

  • A true hands-on mentality — as comfortable executing as designing the process

  • Confident managing external partners and aligning cross-functional teams

  • Comfortable with e-commerce and operations tools, e.g. Shopify, Claude, Notion

  • Structured, detail-oriented, and ownership-driven working style

  • Fluent in English and German; Italian is a plus

  • Full-time (100%), based in or around Munich (office option in Munich), but remote-first way of working


Your benefits

  • Bootstrapped and long-term oriented start-up, allowing you to take responsibility and actively shape the growth path of ALEMI

  • Competitive salary and ALEMI product perks, e.g. an ALEMI bag of your choice as a sign-on bonus, 30% discount on all products, and a special ALEMI birthday present

  • Fair holiday and absence regulation, i.e. 30 days of paid leave per year for full-time employees, sabbatical, and additional days off on special occasions

  • Remote-first working setup without core hours or face time

  • An individual learning & development path, e.g. a yearly budget for external training, coaching & conferences, internal knowledge-sharing sessions, and regular feedback & development talks

  • An inspiring team and culture: an ambitious team with strong ownership, female leadership, an output-oriented culture with a “don’t ask for permission, ask for forgiveness” mentality

  • Regular virtual and onsite team events

  • The latest IT and software set-up, e.g. Shopify, Claude, Notion, GetKLAR, Personio

  • Unlimited Claude Tokens to build your dream set-up (if justified)
