title: Forward Deployment Strategist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ILLUIN Technology
description_html:
À propos de nAIxt Consulting / ILLUIN Technology

nAIxt Consulting est la practice conseil d'ILLUIN Technology, société née en 2017 au cœur de CentraleSupélec, l'un des clusters IA de référence en Europe. Spécialisée dans l'IA appliquée dans les entreprises (grands groupes, comptes publics, ETI, PME), ILLUIN est pionnière du NLP francophone et mène ses propres recherches en IA générative. Nos consultants interviennent en immersion chez le client pour déployer des solutions IA à fort impact (assistants conversationnels, automatisation documentaire, analyse de données), avec la vision agnostique des technologies IA (solutions du marché, produits Illuin, des approches sur mesure).

Le rôle

Nous recherchons plusieurs Forward Deployed Strategist (FDS) pour rejoindre nôtre équipe. Dans ce rôle, vous portez la stratégie d'intégration des solutions IA (de l’automatisation des tâches ponctuelles à la vision Agentic), l'adoption et l'orchestration des transformations IA, en collaboration avec les Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE). Immergé chez le client, vous faites le lien entre les décideurs, les métiers et les équipes de delivery pour transformer le potentiel de l'IA en usages réels et mesurables.

Vous pilotez la transformation IA d'un périmètre métier. Vous construisez la stratégie d'adoption, orchestrez les acteurs (direction, métiers, IT, Data) et garantissez un impact mesurable, du cadrage des cas d'usage jusqu'à l'ancrage des nouveaux usages.

Vos missions

Stratégie & cadrage

  • Construire la feuille de route IA d'un périmètre métier et la faire vivre

  • Qualifier et prioriser le portefeuille de cas d'usage selon la valeur, la faisabilité et les risques

  • Concevoir les processus cibles intégrant l'IA et les agents, et définir les interactions entre l'humain et l'IA

  • Construire les business cases et les critères Go / No Go avec les décideurs

  • Identifier dès le cadrage les prérequis de sécurité, de gouvernance et de qualité des données

  • Éclairer les arbitrages entre produits existants et développements sur mesure (Make vs Buy)

Orchestration de la transformation

  • Dialoguer d'égal à égal avec le Delivery Manager sur l'avancement, les risques et les arbitrages priorité/délai/périmètre

  • Être en mesure d'assurer un pilotage projet de bout en bout sur des missions à faible volumétrie ne justifiant pas un Delivery Manager dédié

  • Aligner direction, métiers, IT et Data autour d'objectifs et d'un plan partagés

  • Séquencer les déploiements pour que chaque cas d'usage renforce le suivant

  • Planifier les déploiements, anticiper les dépendances et lever les blocages

  • Piloter le passage des pilotes à l'échelle avec les équipes de delivery ILLUIN

  • Préparer et animer les instances de pilotage (Coproj, Copil)

Adoption & conduite du changement

  • Concevoir la stratégie d'adoption (formation, communication, relais métiers, rituels)

  • Construire les plans de montée en compétences

  • Installer et animer des réseaux d'ambassadeurs IA chez le client

  • Identifier les résistances et mettre en place les réponses adaptées

Impact & mesure

  • Définir et suivre les KPIs d'adoption et d'impact (taux d'usage, temps gagné, qualité, économies opérationnelles)

  • Mesurer les résultats et les présenter aux décideurs en comitologie

  • Mettre en place les dispositifs de retours utilisateurs et d'amélioration continue

  • Ajuster la trajectoire de déploiement selon les signaux terrain

Vie du cabinet

  • Encadrer et faire progresser des consultants juniors en mission

  • Contribuer à la prospection commerciale, aux propositions et aux soutenances

  • Capitaliser les retours d'expérience et enrichir les méthodologies et playbooks du cabinet

Profil recherché : avant tout, vous êtes passionné(e) par l’IA et souhaitez contribuer pour la rendre véritablement utile pour les entreprises

Formation

  • Bac+5 école d'ingénieur, école de commerce ou université

  • Spécialisation ou formation complémentaire en Data / IA et/ou en conduite du changement fortement appréciée

Expérience

  • 3 à 7 ans d'expérience, dont 2 ans au moins sur des projets IA, data ou transformation numérique

  • Vous avez accompagné au moins 2 projets de déploiement IA de bout en bout, du cadrage à l'adoption

  • Vous avez déjà préparé et animé des instances de Project Management et de pilotage face à des décideurs

  • Expérience en contexte grands comptes ou cabinet de conseil est fortement appréciable

  • Anglais courant est un plus

Outils & compétences techniques

  • Fondamentaux IA (LLM, RAG, agents) suffisants pour évaluer une faisabilité et dialoguer avec les Data Scientists

  • Construction de business cases chiffrés et de grilles de priorisation

  • Construction et présentation de dashboards (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker)

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux data, gouvernance, sécurité et éthique IA

  • Compréhension générale des architectures cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Notions de gestion de projet (planning, jalons, gestion des risques, méthodes Agile) suffisantes pour dialoguer avec un Delivery Manager et, si besoin, piloter seul un projet de moindre envergure

Compétences clés

  • Capacité à embarquer des acteurs aux intérêts parfois divergents

  • Data storytelling, vous présentez des résultats chiffrés de façon convaincante aux décideurs

  • Capacité à naviguer l'ambiguïté des grandes organisations

  • Veille IA active, vous intégrez les évolutions du marché dans vos recommandations

  • Orientation résultats, vous cherchez l'impact avant la production de livrables

Contacts

description_html:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then, Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

Simultaneously, we support accounting firms by enabling them to spend less time on redundant and repetitive tasks and more time on advising and supporting their clients. Already, over 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and more than 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! 🚀

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1100+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Senior Software Engineer?

As a Senior Software Engineer at Pennylane, your squad is your primary focus. You will contribute to building reliable, scalable and user-focused products, while helping the engineers around you grow and raising the quality of our technical execution. You will:

  • Understand and frame user and product problems, using your product knowledge to help your squad deliver simple, pragmatic and valuable solutions.

  • Lead significant technical deliveries within your squad, from understanding the problem to designing, implementing, testing and operating the solution in production.

  • Investigate and resolve complex production issues, using monitoring, observability and data analysis tools to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

  • Design and evolve robust solutions, identifying performance, scalability and reliability opportunities and turning them into pragmatic technical improvements.

  • Bring strong expertise in at least one major part of our stack, while being able to join a new team and become autonomous on a high-impact initiative within a few weeks.

  • Improve engineering practices across the organization, through high-quality code reviews, pair programming, documentation, RFCs and the adoption of AI-assisted development without compromising software quality.

  • Act as a role model and a driver for other engineers, sharing knowledge, providing actionable feedback and helping the team continuously improve its technical skills and ways of working.

  • Collaborate effectively with other teams when needed, proactively unblocking technical topics and clearly communicating progress, risks, decisions and results to the relevant stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the Pennylane tech community, through technical content, onboarding, interviews, incident resolution, tech initiatives, meetups or other community-building activities.

 

🥇 You’re the right candidate if you…

  • Have strong hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and React (at least 7-8 years)

  • Combine technical expertise with strong product and business understanding, enjoy solving complex problems and care deeply about your users.

  • Are a collaborative team player, communicate clearly and take ownership of delivering reliable, pragmatic solutions.

  • Like being challenged and solving complex problems (accounting is complex in Europe)

  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

 
 

🎁 What we offer

  • 🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

  • 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 30 vacations days paid by Pennylane

  • 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

  • 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

  • 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

  • ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

  • 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

  • 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

  • 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

  1. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 13 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

  2. We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 
 

🤝Hiring process

  • You will first have a general chat with a Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

  • You’ll then have a test-home assignment + a debriefing session with two of our software engineers (1 hour)

  • You’ll have a last culture-fit discussion with two people from our tech leadership (1 h)

 

We make sure we move fast ; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment. We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. title: SEO & AI Content Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Pennylane SAS
description_html:
Why this role exists

At Pennylane, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) are central to making our product easier to discover and understand, while helping us reach new customers.

We are looking for an SEO & AI Content Specialist to work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team. Your mission will be to produce, improve and scale high-quality content that drives non-branded organic traffic and conversions, while embedding AI thoughtfully into the way we work.

This role is for someone who enjoys writing, structuring, optimising, measuring and iterating. You are curious about the evolution of search and eager to explore how people discover products through search engines and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and enable accountants to focus on advising their clients.

A few figures that illustrate our scale and ambition:

💻 More than 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane.

🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 More than 1,100 Pennylaners work across the company, representing more than 25 nationalities.

💰 More than €400 million raised since launch.

🌍 A remote-friendly, international culture as we continue to grow across Europe.

What you’ll do

You will work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team and :

Build AI-powered content workflows

  • Use AI to accelerate research, outlining, first drafts and content optimisation, while maintaining a high editorial standard.

  • Design repeatable workflows, including briefs, quality checklists, templates and editorial guidelines.

  • Help scale content production efficiently without compromising relevance, accuracy or clarity.

Produce and optimise high-value SEO content

  • Write, update and improve SEO content, including articles, pillar pages and landing pages, to generate non-branded organic traffic and conversions.

  • Turn search intent into clear, useful and well-structured content for Pennylane’s audiences.

  • Run continuous optimisation initiatives, including content refreshes, consolidation, internal linking and on-page improvements.

  • Work with stakeholders across Growth to ensure content supports broader acquisition priorities.

Help develop our GEO approach

  • Build an understanding of the questions and prompts prospects use in AI-powered discovery tools.

  • Adapt content to help ensure Pennylane is accurately understood and discoverable across emerging AI search journeys.

  • Test content formats, structures and optimisation approaches that improve visibility in AI-generated answers — without compromising the experience for human readers.

  • Share learnings and contribute to shaping Pennylane’s evolving SEO and GEO playbook.

Make decisions with data

  • Monitor and prioritise work based on SEO performance signals, including visibility, rankings, impressions, clicks, CTR, organic traffic and conversions.

  • Translate data into concrete, actionable recommendations.

  • Run experiments, measure their impact and iterate quickly and rigorously.

What you bring

  • You have initial, meaningful hands-on experience in SEO, ideally with published content you can share.

  • You are fluent in French, with strong writing and editing skills. You also have professional working proficiency in English.

  • You enjoy improving content and are motivated by the challenge of turning a good page into a high-performing one.

  • You take a pragmatic, data-informed approach: you form hypotheses, test them, measure outcomes and improve.

  • You already use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow and are excited to deepen your practice.

  • You have a sharp eye for structure, clarity, accuracy and editorial quality.

  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving, collaborative environment and know how to focus on the initiatives with the greatest business impact.

🛠️ Tools and environment

You will work with tools such as Meteoria, Profound, Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, Contentful and Notion.

What you can expect

  • A role with real room to propose, structure and improve how SEO works at Pennylane.

  • The opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of SEO, content, GEO and AI.

  • A demanding and supportive team that values execution, learning and sound judgement.

  • A direct and visible impact on organic acquisition and conversion.

  • A remote-friendly working environment, with access to home-office equipment, coworking options where relevant and regular opportunities to meet teammates in person.

  • Benefits that support flexibility, wellbeing, connection and growth. These may vary depending on your country, contract type and role.

📍 Location and working model

This role can be based in Paris on a hybrid basis, or remotely from anywhere in France.

🔎 Our recruitment process

All interviews are held remotely:

  1. An initial conversation with Talent Acquisition (30 min).

  2. A conversation with the Hiring Manager (30 min).

  3. A case study and debrief with the Hiring Manager and a team member (1 hour).

  4. A final team-fit conversation with a Marketing Team Lead (30 min).

🌈 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Pennylane is committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment, with equal opportunities for all candidates regardless of social or ethnic background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability or any other personal characteristic.

We know that some people are less likely to apply when they do not meet every single requirement. If this role sounds exciting and you believe you could make an impact, we would love to hear from you.

⚠️ Important information for candidates

Please apply only through Pennylane’s official channels. Our communications are sent from email addresses ending in @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com.

We will never ask you to make a payment or share financial information during the recruitment process.

description_html:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our product principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Role context

 

  • The Financial Services track is looking for a Senior Product Design Manager to lead its design team as the current design leader transitions into a broader product leadership role.

     

  • This role will be central to raising experience quality across Financial Services, maintaining coherence with the wider SME product, and designing high-converting experiences that contribute to Pennylane’s acquisition and revenue goals.

 

Main responsibilities

  • Lead, support, and develop a team of four Product Designers and one first-time Design Manager, all reporting directly to you.

  • Coach the Design Manager in building strong management practices, developing team members, and creating the conditions for high performance.

  • Set a clear design direction for Financial Services, translating product and business priorities into an actionable experience strategy.

  • Raise the quality and consistency of customer experiences across the Financial Services journey while ensuring coherence with the broader SME product.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and other stakeholders to design experiences that support acquisition, activation, conversion, and revenue objectives.

    Guide designers through complex product challenges, strengthening craft, strategic thinking, customer understanding, and measurable impact.

    Represent Financial Services in cross-functional Brand and Design System initiatives, contributing to shared standards while ensuring that the track’s specific needs are addressed.

 
 

Profile we’re looking for

 

You have significant experience leading Product Design teams in complex, fast-moving product environments.

You are comfortable managing both individual contributors and design managers, including coaching someone through their first management role.

You can define a compelling design direction and connect customer experience decisions with product strategy and business outcomes.

You have a strong track record of improving the quality, usability, and coherence of end-to-end digital experiences.

You understand how design contributes to acquisition, activation, conversion, and revenue, and you use qualitative and quantitative insights to guide decisions.

You can deliver and demonstrate measurable results within short cycles without losing sight of long-term experience quality and customer trust.

You can navigate complex product ecosystems and balance local team needs with consistency across a broader platform.

You build effective partnerships with Product, Engineering, Data, Brand, Marketing, and senior stakeholders.

You provide clear, actionable feedback and create an environment where designers can grow, challenge ideas, and produce their best work.

You speak french and english.

Experience with financial services or another regulated, trust-sensitive product environment is a plus, but not essential.


What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

description_html:
Why this role exists

At Pennylane, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) are central to making our product easier to discover and understand, while helping us reach new customers.

We are looking for an SEO & AI Content Specialist to work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team. Your mission will be to produce, improve and scale high-quality content that drives non-branded organic traffic and conversions, while embedding AI thoughtfully into the way we work.

This role is for someone who enjoys writing, structuring, optimising, measuring and iterating. You are curious about the evolution of search and eager to explore how people discover products through search engines and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and enable accountants to focus on advising their clients.

A few figures that illustrate our scale and ambition:

💻 More than 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane.

🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 More than 1,100 Pennylaners work across the company, representing more than 25 nationalities.

💰 More than €400 million raised since launch.

🌍 A remote-friendly, international culture as we continue to grow across Europe.

What you’ll do

You will work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team and :

Build AI-powered content workflows

  • Use AI to accelerate research, outlining, first drafts and content optimisation, while maintaining a high editorial standard.

  • Design repeatable workflows, including briefs, quality checklists, templates and editorial guidelines.

  • Help scale content production efficiently without compromising relevance, accuracy or clarity.

Produce and optimise high-value SEO content

  • Write, update and improve SEO content, including articles, pillar pages and landing pages, to generate non-branded organic traffic and conversions.

  • Turn search intent into clear, useful and well-structured content for Pennylane’s audiences.

  • Run continuous optimisation initiatives, including content refreshes, consolidation, internal linking and on-page improvements.

  • Work with stakeholders across Growth to ensure content supports broader acquisition priorities.

Help develop our GEO approach

  • Build an understanding of the questions and prompts prospects use in AI-powered discovery tools.

  • Adapt content to help ensure Pennylane is accurately understood and discoverable across emerging AI search journeys.

  • Test content formats, structures and optimisation approaches that improve visibility in AI-generated answers — without compromising the experience for human readers.

  • Share learnings and contribute to shaping Pennylane’s evolving SEO and GEO playbook.

Make decisions with data

  • Monitor and prioritise work based on SEO performance signals, including visibility, rankings, impressions, clicks, CTR, organic traffic and conversions.

  • Translate data into concrete, actionable recommendations.

  • Run experiments, measure their impact and iterate quickly and rigorously.

What you bring

  • You have initial, meaningful hands-on experience in SEO, ideally with published content you can share.

  • You are fluent in French, with strong writing and editing skills. You also have professional working proficiency in English.

  • You enjoy improving content and are motivated by the challenge of turning a good page into a high-performing one.

  • You take a pragmatic, data-informed approach: you form hypotheses, test them, measure outcomes and improve.

  • You already use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow and are excited to deepen your practice.

  • You have a sharp eye for structure, clarity, accuracy and editorial quality.

  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving, collaborative environment and know how to focus on the initiatives with the greatest business impact.

🛠️ Tools and environment

You will work with tools such as Meteoria, Profound, Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, Contentful and Notion.

What you can expect

  • A role with real room to propose, structure and improve how SEO works at Pennylane.

  • The opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of SEO, content, GEO and AI.

  • A demanding and supportive team that values execution, learning and sound judgement.

  • A direct and visible impact on organic acquisition and conversion.

  • A remote-friendly working environment, with access to home-office equipment, coworking options where relevant and regular opportunities to meet teammates in person.

  • Benefits that support flexibility, wellbeing, connection and growth. These may vary depending on your country, contract type and role.

📍 Location and working model

This role can be based in Paris on a hybrid basis, or remotely from anywhere in France.

🔎 Our recruitment process

All interviews are held remotely:

  1. An initial conversation with Talent Acquisition (30 min).

  2. A conversation with the Hiring Manager (30 min).

  3. A case study and debrief with the Hiring Manager and a team member (1 hour).

  4. A final team-fit conversation with a Marketing Team Lead (30 min).

🌈 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Pennylane is committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment, with equal opportunities for all candidates regardless of social or ethnic background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability or any other personal characteristic.

We know that some people are less likely to apply when they do not meet every single requirement. If this role sounds exciting and you believe you could make an impact, we would love to hear from you.

⚠️ Important information for candidates

Please apply only through Pennylane’s official channels. Our communications are sent from email addresses ending in @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com.

We will never ask you to make a payment or share financial information during the recruitment process.

title: Head of People Partnering & Development
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Pennylane SAS
description_html:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Accompagne la croissance de Pennylane en faisant travailler ensemble les HRBPs et le People Development

Pennylane est une scale-up fintech de 1 200 collaborateurs, présente en France, en Allemagne et en Espagne. Dans un contexte de forte croissance, d’expansion européenne et de transformation des métiers par l’IA, nous recrutons notre futur·e Head of People Partnering & Development.

Rattaché·e à la VP People, tu travailleras au plus près du COMEX et des leaders de l’entreprise.

Ta mission

Ta mission sera d’accompagner la croissance de Pennylane en faisant travailler ensemble deux disciplines complémentaires :

  • les HRBPs, qui accompagnent les équipes, les managers et les organisations au plus près des enjeux business ;

  • le People Development, qui porte le développement des compétences, la performance, les career paths, la gestion des talents et les programmes managers.

Tu veilleras à connecter ces expertises afin de proposer une approche People cohérente, internationale et directement alignée avec les priorités business.

Tes principales responsabilités

Stratégie People et accompagnement du business

  • Construire et piloter la roadmap commune HRBP et People Development ;

  • accompagner les enjeux organisationnels liés à la croissance et à l’internationalisation ;

  • conseiller et challenger les leaders sur leurs enjeux d’organisation, de management et de talents ;

  • développer une approche People fondée sur la donnée et l’anticipation ;

  • suivre les indicateurs clés : turnover, engagement, performance, capacité organisationnelle et développement des compétences.

Coordination internationale

  • Garantir une approche cohérente entre la France, l’Allemagne et l’Espagne ;

  • coordonner les sujets cross-country : mobilité, career paths, performance et pratiques managériales ;

  • trouver le bon équilibre entre harmonisation internationale et spécificités locales ;

  • contribuer à la construction d’une culture commune.

Management et collaboration des équipes

  • Manager et développer une équipe d’environ 11 personnes sur les pôles HRBP et People Development ;

  • créer les conditions d’une collaboration efficace entre les deux disciplines ;

  • clarifier les rôles, les responsabilités et les modes de fonctionnement ;

  • renforcer la posture stratégique et l’influence de l’équipe auprès des leaders ;

  • développer les compétences de l’équipe sur la data, le change et l’IA.

Talents, performance et développement

  • Piloter la stratégie Learning & Development ;

  • structurer les cycles de performance et les calibrations ;

  • développer les career paths, le job grading et le levelling ;

  • piloter les talent reviews et le succession planning ;

  • développer les programmes managers ;

  • accompagner les initiatives liées à l’engagement, à la culture et à la reconnaissance.

IA et transformation des métiers

  • Anticiper l’impact de l’IA sur les métiers, les compétences et les organisations ;

  • identifier les cas d’usage pertinents pour la fonction People ;

  • accompagner les équipes et les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ;

  • intégrer l’IA dans les pratiques HRBP et People Development de manière utile et responsable.

Le profil recherché

Tu as 8 à 12 ans d’expérience en RH, dont au moins 3 à 4 ans dans un rôle de leadership, par exemple :

  • DRH ou Head of People dans une entreprise tech de 200 à 600 collaborateurs ;

  • Head of HRBP dans une scale-up ou une entreprise en forte croissance ;

  • Head of HRBP dans un grand groupe

Tu as déjà structuré une fonction RH ou HRBP, recruté et développé une équipe, travaillé avec des dirigeants et accompagné une organisation en croissance. Une expérience internationale et une première pratique de l’IA dans un contexte RH seront particulièrement appréciées.

Ce qui fera la différence

Tu combines :

  • une forte compréhension des enjeux business et organisationnels ;

  • une capacité à influencer et challenger les leaders ;

  • un vrai talent pour faire travailler ensemble des expertises différentes ;

  • une approche structurée, data-driven et orientée résultats ;

  • de la curiosité pour l’IA et les nouvelles technologies ;

  • du courage managérial, de l’humilité et le goût du collectif.

Les dimensions du poste

  • Périmètre : 1 100 collaborateurs ;

  • Pays : France, Allemagne et Espagne ;

  • Équipe : environ 11 personnes ;

  • Rattachement : VP People ;

  • Interlocuteurs clés : COMEX, Directors, Heads of, Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Legal et Compensation.

Processus de recrutement

- 1ère échange avec Nathalie, Talent Acquisition - 45min

- Entretien avec Marine, VP people (1 h)

- Étude de cas à réaliser chez soi, suivie d’un débriefing avec Marine et Felix, Co-fondateur (1 h)

- Dernier entretien avec les leads People (TA et People Ops) + échange avec les HRBP (30-45 min)

Nous tenons également à souligner que nous adhérons pleinement aux principes de diversité, d’équité et d’inclusion, et que nous mettons tout en œuvre pour créer un environnement sûr et inclusif.
Nous nous engageons à offrir l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi, sans distinction de genre, d’orientation sexuelle, d’origine, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique qui fait de vous ce que vous êtes. Au contraire, la diversité rend notre lieu de travail encore plus agréable.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins enclines à postuler que d’autres si elles ont l’impression de ne pas répondre à l’ensemble des critères.

 

Si vous hésitez, nous vous encourageons à postuler : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d’une collaboration enrichissante et durable.

Que faisons-nous pour faciliter votre vie professionnelle ?

🌴 Quel que soit votre lieu de travail, vous bénéficierez de 25 jours de congés payés par Pennylane

💵 Vous bénéficierez d’une rémunération compétitive

📈 Vous recevrez des actions de l’entreprise pour profiter d’une part de la réussite que vous construisez avec nous

🏡 Vous disposerez d’un budget pour transformer votre domicile en un espace de travail plus confortable, ainsi que d’une allocation mensuelle pour travailler dans un espace de coworking quand vous le souhaitez

⛹️ Grâce à notre partenaire Gymlib, vous aurez accès à 8 000 salles de sport en Europe et à plus de 300 activités liées au bien-être

🇬🇧 Vous aurez accès à Busuu pour perfectionner votre anglais ou votre français

💻 Vous disposerez des derniers équipements Apple

🏢 En fonction des équipes et des exigences du poste, vous pourrez travailler à distance


Si vous êtes basé en France, vous bénéficierez d’un contrat de travail français conforme à la réglementation française, en plus des avantages suivants : 6 à 12 jours de RTT, 5 semaines de congés payés, des crédits repas (Swile), une couverture santé Alan Blue et des événements réguliers dans les villes où les Pennylaners sont les plus nombreux (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

 

Nous travaillons à étendre ces derniers avantages à nos collaborateurs basés hors de France, mais cela peut s’avérer plus complexe selon les pays.

 

Informations importantes pour les candidats

 

Les tentatives d’escroquerie à l’embauche sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilants lors de vos échanges.

title: Product Manager (Protocol)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Morpho
description_html:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

 

Role

Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work.

This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

  • Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

  • Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

  • Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

  • Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

  • Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

  • Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.

 

First 3 months

You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.

 

First 6 months

You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

 

Must Have Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments.

  • Proven track record taking products or major features from ambiguous problem spaces through launch and iteration.

  • Strong technical fluency, with the ability to reason about system design and constraints, engage deeply with engineers and researchers, and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent product judgment: you can distinguish important user problems from requests, make principled tradeoffs, and focus teams on the work with the greatest impact.

  • Strong user discovery and synthesis skills, with the ability to uncover needs across different user types and turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear direction.

  • Experience leading cross-functional work without relying on formal authority.

  • Ability to define success, use quantitative and qualitative evidence, and adapt direction as new information emerges.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, especially in an async environment.

  • Comfort creating clarity and driving decisions in highly ambiguous contexts.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: you act without waiting to be told.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience in crypto, DeFi, traditional finance, or fintech.

  • Familiarity with lending markets, smart contracts, or permissionless protocols.

  • Experience shipping products with significant security, audit, regulatory, or governance considerations.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

description_html:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 3500+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product Demo

  • Meet the team

  • Article on our seed round of 5,5M$

Context

We're experiencing one of the strongest growth rates in the French Tech ecosystem: we're targeting €10M ARR by the end of 2026. To achieve this, we need to triple the sales team while increasing productivity, and therefore the ARR signed per account executive.

Your mission

At the end of your first year, you will have built a system in which our SDRs spend zero time on bad leads and 100% of their time on high-intent, well-qualified, properly enriched prospects.

You own the GTM infrastructure end-to-end. You sit at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Data. You report to the Head of RevOps, your main "client" is the Sales team.

This is an A to Z hands-on role. You define the strategy, build the workflows, run them, iterate.

 

Responsibilities

Pipeline Generation & Qualification

  • Design and maintain automated lead sourcing workflows (Clay, Apollo, Pharow, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)

  • Build enrichment pipelines: firmographics, intent signals, tech stack, hiring activity

  • Define ICP scoring models and qualification criteria

  • Reduce SDR time spent on prospecting, give them lists they can act on immediately

GTM Tooling & Automation

  • Own the outbound stack: sequencing tools, enrichment tools, data providers

  • Build and maintain integrations between tools (CRM, enrichment, outreach, tracking)

  • Automate manual tasks: list building, data deduplication, routing, assignment

  • Ensure data flows cleanly from source → CRM (Attio)

CRM & Data Hygiene

  • Keep the pipeline clean: right stages, right fields, right owners

  • Instrument touchpoints (emails, calls, LinkedIn, demos) in the CRM

  • Monitor data completeness; kill dead weight in the funnel

GTM Analytics

  • Build dashboards on pipeline quality (source, stage conversion, cycle length)

  • Track SDR performance vs. list quality, surface the correlation

  • Identify funnel leaks and fix them

What this is NOT

  • Not a pure ops role, you build things that run without you

  • Not a data analyst role, dashboards serve decisions, not decoration

  • Not a "manage the CRM" role, you redesign how it works

Expected outcomes

1 month

  • Full audit of the current outbound stack and lead sources

  • Map the SDR workflow end-to-end: where is time wasted, where does quality drop

  • First enrichment pipeline running in production

3 months

  • Fully automated ICP-qualified lead lists delivered to SDRs weekly

  • Enrichment coverage >80% on key signals (industry, headcount, tech stack, intent)

  • Outbound stack rationalized and documented

  • Pipeline dashboards live and trusted

6–12 months

  • GTM infrastructure that scales without adding headcount

  • SDRs spending <20% of time on list building / data ops

  • Measurable improvement in SQL rate and pipeline coverage

  • Company ready to scale outbound x3 with the same tooling

This role is for you if

  • 2–6 years in RevOps, Sales Ops, BizOps, Growth Ops in a SaaS / startup that scaled

  • Very strong with tools and wants to build from the ground up (CRM, spreadsheets, automation)

  • Structured thinker, you prioritize your task according to the impact on your yearly mission : scale sales and attain 10M in ARR.

  • You're structured, pragmatic, and execution-driven

  • You're comfortable working directly with founders

  • You care about data, but even more about things actually working

  • Fluent in French, Professional English

Benefits

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

  • MacBook provided.

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company).

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered.

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Recruitment process

1️⃣ Discovery call (30 min) with our Talent Acquisition Manager

2️⃣ Hiring Manager interview (45 min) with Robin, Head of Revops

3️⃣ Case study (1hr) with Alexandre, and Robin

3️⃣ Culture / founder fit (1hr) with Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

4️⃣ Reference check

5️⃣ Offer ! 🎉

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Data Annotator

description_html:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Data Annotator within the Visual Navigation team, you work at the foundation of how our autonomous systems interpret their environment. You review large volumes of image datasets and apply precise, consistent annotations that directly feed the training and validation of our computer vision and machine learning models. You collaborate closely with our Computer Vision, Data Architecture, and Machine Learning teams to ensure the data you deliver meets the rigor required for real-world deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze, label, and annotate diverse image datasets to support the training and validation of our AI models.

  • Follow detailed annotation guidelines precisely, maintaining consistency across large batches of work.

  • Review AI model outputs for accuracy and contextual relevance, flagging discrepancies against expected results.

  • Perform annotation peer-review with other members of the Annotation team to ensure consistency and quality.

  • Communicate findings and edge cases to the AI and Data Engineering teams.

  • Occasionally support field test campaigns to help with on-site data collection.

Candidate Requirements

  • Baccalauréat (or equivalent); no specific prior qualification required.

  • Meticulous attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accuracy across long, repetitive tasks.

  • Comfortable using digital tools and following strict, well-defined project guidelines.

  • Ability to work consistently and reliably within a structured, process-driven environment.

  • Previous experience in data-labeling, annotation, or content-evaluation is a plus.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills.

  • Fluency in French required; English is a plus.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

description_html:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Automated Testing Module Lead, you take ownership of how Harmattan validates its autonomy and flight-software stack. Today, our software is validated mostly against real hardware, a process that consumes airframes, range time, and crew while sampling only a handful of nominal trajectories. The cases we actually build for, such as degraded GNSS, sensor dropout, electronic warfare, and multi-agent situations, are rarely reached economically that way. Your mission is to establish the scenario library, execution strategy, and interface bricks to turn our existing simulation platform into a fast, reliable, and continuous validation engine.

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You inherit an active team of four engineers across Paris and Lausanne, with a target of around eight by mid-2027. Beyond leading the team, you become the technical authority on our scenario-based testing: defining what runs across SITL, HITL, and CI, holding critical technical boundaries with adjacent teams, and bridging the gap between simulation fidelity and real flight data.

What You Will Do

  • Team Leadership & Strategy: Take over, structure, and give a clear mandate to our existing team of four engineers, while building the case and the roadmap to scale the module to around eight by mid-2027.
    Scenario & Simulation Engineering: Drive the design of a versioned scenario library covering nominal, edge, off-nominal, and contested flight conditions, expanding into Monte Carlo and multi-agent testing, and bring a team with no prior simulation experience up that curve.

  • Execution Strategy & Gating: Establish what tests run across SITL, HITL, and CI, defining gating policies, telemetry capture, deterministic replay, and coverage analytics.

  • Interface & Boundary Ownership: Negotiate, then maintain, strong, written technical boundaries with Tooling (who provide the simulation platform) and co-ownership splits with Validation (who define acceptance criteria and own final sign-off).

  • Sim-to-Real Correlation: Correlate simulation models against real flight data to continuously measure and close the sim-to-real gap, ensuring green test gates reflect real-world flight readiness.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years in automated testing, simulation-based validation, or test engineering for complex physical / hardware-in-the-loop systems (e.g., Autonomous Driving, Aerospace, Defense, Robotics).
    Scenario & Simulation Depth: Hands-on experience designing scenario-based test suites on a simulation platform and defining coverage that genuinely catches defects. This is the capability our current team lacks, and therefore the most valuable thing you can bring.

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on proficiency in Python, C++, Linux, Docker, and CI environments, with deep domain expertise in scenario design, SITL/HITL execution, and simulation tools.

  • Leadership & Ownership: Proven ability to step into an existing engineering team, establish immediate clarity, and manage distributed engineers (Paris and Lausanne) effectively**, including engineers more senior than you in years of experience**.

  • Validation Mindset: A rigorous, analytical approach to noisy physical metrics, false positives, and flaky test environments, instinctively questioning what a passing test proves.

  • Cross-Functional Diplomacy: Track record of defining and holding clear interfaces with platform providers and internal customer teams.
    Bonus: Background in defense/aerospace flight software, control systems, or experience closing sim-to-real fidelity gaps.

  • Location & Travel: Based in Paris or Lausanne, with travel between sites. Working-
    level English.

What We Offer

  • Immediate Impact: Take over an established mandate with an existing team and pre-built simulation platform, delivering test capability in weeks rather than building from scratch.

  • High System Scope: Own the entire scenario library and execution strategy across our autonomy stack.
    Direct Mission Impact: Build test pipelines that directly accelerate the deployment of resilient autonomous systems in real-world defense environments.
    Cross-Functional Ownership: Work closely with Tooling, Validation, GNC, Perception, and Embedded SW teams to shape the future of flight-software reliability.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Technicien Qualité (Quality Technician)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Signal Processing Engineer (RF Processing & Analytics)
description_html:
À propos

Harmattan AI est un acteur de nouvelle génération dans le secteur de la défense, spécialisé dans la conception de systèmes autonomes et évolutifs. En combinant ingénierie avancée, robotique et intelligence artificielle, nous développons des capacités opérationnelles pensées pour le terrain.

Notre croissance rapide reflète une ambition claire : équiper les forces armées avec des systèmes à la hauteur des enjeux actuels. Nous recherchons des profils prêts à s’engager dans un environnement technique exigeant, avec un fort sens de la mission et de l’impact.

 
 

Rôle

Nous recherchons un Technicien Qualité pour rejoindre notre bureau de Paris. En travaillant sur le terrain aux côtés des équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et de qualité, vous veillerez à ce que la qualité soit intégrée à nos produits, du prototype jusqu'à la livraison au client. Vous rapporterez au Responsable Qualité.

 
 

Responsabilités

Support à la fabrication de prototypes :

  • Fournir un support qualité lors de l'assemblage des prototypes, en veillant à ce que les constructions soient conformes aux plans, aux instructions de travail et aux spécifications.

  • Identifier et documenter les pièces non conformes, soutenir le traitement et les actions correctives aux côtés de l'équipe d'ingénierie.

  • Aider à définir les méthodes d'inspection et les critères d'acceptation pour les nouveaux composants.

 

Revue de premier article (FAI) :

  • Réaliser des revues de premier article sur les pièces de développement.

  • Préparer et maintenir les rapports FAI avec une traçabilité complète des résultats d'inspection.

  • Assurer le suivi des conclusions de la FAI et veiller à ce que les actions correctives soient clôturées avant la mise en production.

 

Mur Qualité – Produits en développement :

  • Gérer le point de contrôle du mur qualité, en vérifiant que chaque unité de développement répond aux critères définis avant de passer à la phase suivante.

  • Tenir à jour les registres du mur qualité et donner de la visibilité sur l'état des produits et les motifs de blocage.

  • Faire remonter les défauts récurrents à l'Ingénierie Qualité et à la Conception pour résolution.

 

Support après-vente et tri chez le client :

  • Participer aux activités de support après-vente, y compris l'inspection sur site et le tri des produits chez les clients si nécessaire.

  • Effectuer des contrôles visuels et dimensionnels pour identifier les unités non conformes, isoler les produits défectueux et documenter les résultats.

  • Agir en tant que représentant qualité sur site, assurant la liaison entre le client et les équipes internes pour résoudre efficacement les problèmes de qualité.

  • Remonter les observations du terrain au centre de développement pour piloter les actions correctives et l'amélioration des produits.

 

Système Qualité et Amélioration Continue :

  • Veiller à ce que les rapports d'inspection et de non-conformité soient correctement documentés dans les outils appropriés (Jira, Confluence ou QMS).

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus d'inspection et des critères du mur qualité au fil du temps.

 

Prérequis

  • Diplôme technique en qualité, génie mécanique, fabrication ou domaine connexe.

  • Première expérience dans un rôle d'inspection qualité ou de qualité fabrication, idéalement dans les secteurs de l'aérospatiale, de la défense ou de la haute technologie.

  • Capacité à lire des dessins d'ingénierie et à utiliser les outils d'inspection standards (pieds à coulisse, micromètres, etc.).

  • La connaissance des processus de revue de premier article (FAI) est un plus.

  • Connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et EN 9100.

  • Minutieux, rigoureux et à l'aise pour travailler en atelier.

  • Esprit d'équipe et bonnes compétences en communication.

  • Bon niveau d'anglais ; disponibilité pour se déplacer sur les sites des clients si nécessaire.

  • Adhésion totale à la mission de Harmattan AI et volonté de s'investir pleinement pour soutenir notre croissance.

 

Nous avons hâte de découvrir comment vous pouvez aider à façonner l'avenir des systèmes de défense autonomes chez Harmattan AI.

title: Senior CRM / Lifecycle Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Next Lotto GmbH
description_html:
Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern! Ok…ersetzten wir das Papier durch eine App und eine Person gegen 600.000+ Nutzer monatlich. This is our Business!

📌 Deine Mission

Als Senior CRM / Lifecycle Manager (m/w/d) treibst Du das Herzstück unserer Wachstumsstrategie voran: Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche End-to-End-Verantwortung für die Player Journey nach der Akquisition und transformierst App-Installationen und Erstspieler in begeisterte, loyale und wertvolle Nutzer. Dein klares Ziel: Die Retention-Kurve und den Player Lifetime Value auf ein neues Level zu heben, Churn konsequent zu minimieren und jeden in das Marketing investierten Euro durch eine meisterhafte Bindungsstrategie maximal zu hebeln.

Auf den Punkt gebrach -> Du baust das fundamentale Lifecycle-Programm von Grund auf auf, schützt den Wert unserer expandierenden Nutzerbasis und machst sie nachhaltig zu unserem größten Wachstumsmotor!

Aufgaben

  • Operative Steuerung und Optimierung der täglichen Lifecycle-Kampagnen über Push-Benachrichtigungen, E-Mail und In-App-Messaging in CleverTap.
  • Konzeption, Umsetzung und Betreuung automatisierter Journeys entlang der Phasen Onboarding, Aktivierung, Retention, Winback und Monetarisierung.
  • Entwicklung verhaltens- und lifecycle-basierter Segmentierungs- und Targeting-Logiken zur Sicherstellung der optimalen Botschaft zum richtigen Zeitpunkt.
  • Systematische Durchführung von A/B-Tests hinsichtlich Messaging, Timing, Kanal und Angeboten (Offers) inklusive fortlaufender Dokumentation der Learnings.
  • Analyse von Retention-Kurven, Kohorten, Engagement, Churn sowie des LTVs und Aufbau passender Dashboards in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data-Team.
  • Strategische Steuerung der Post-Acquisition Player Journey und ganzheitliche Verantwortung für den gesamten Lifecycle-Funnel.
  • Enge Abstimmung und Koordination gemeinsamer Initiativen mit den Teams aus Marketing, User Acquisition, Social Media, Data und Product.
  • Sicherstellung aller relevanten Compliance-Anforderungen (insb. GlüStV) sowie Berücksichtigung von Responsible-Gaming-Prinzipien und spezifischen Kommunikationsrichtlinien im Lotterieumfeld.

Qualifikation

Must-have:

  • Tiefgehende, praktische Erfahrung mit Marketing-Automation-Plattformen (z. B. CleverTap, Braze, Leanplum, Iterable, MoEngage) inklusive der eigenständigen technischen Umsetzung von Kampagnen.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der kanalübergreifenden Mobile-Kommunikation via Push-Notifications, E-Mail und In-App-Messaging.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in verhaltensbasierter Segmentierung sowie in der End-to-End-Entwicklung und dem Rollout mehrstufiger, automatisierter Customer Journeys.
  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Auswertung und iterativen Optimierung von A/B-Tests und Experimenten.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Product-Analytics-Tools (z. B. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), im Aufbau von Dashboards sowie in der Analyse von Tabellenmodellen, Retention-Kurven und Kohorten.
  • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis relevanter Mobile-Lifecycle-KPIs wie Churn, LTV, DAU/MAU und Retention-Raten.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse für die tägliche Arbeit im Team.

Softskills:

  • Ownership mindset — Eigenverantwortliches Handeln.
  • Data-driven & experiment-oriented — Datengesteuerte und agile Arbeitsweise.
  • Player-empathy / customer-centric — Starke Kundenorientierung & Empathie.
  • Collaborative — Teamfähigkeit.
  • Detail-oriented — Hohe Detailgenauigkeit.
  • Comfortable with startup ambiguity — Sicherheit im Umgang mit Dynamik.
  • Responsible-gaming mindset — Verantwortungsbewusstsein (Responsible Gaming).

Dein Background:

  • 3–5 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing.
  • Ein starker Hintergrund im Bereich B2C Consumer Apps (Mobile-First, Install-getriebenes Geschäftsmodell) wird ausdrücklich bevorzugt.
  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium oder eine vergleichbare, in der Praxis erworbene Qualifikation.
  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in stark regulierten Branchen wie dem Lotteriewesen, Fintech oder Glücksspiel (iGaming).
  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau einer Lifecycle-Marketing-Struktur aus einer frühen oder sehr schlanken (Lean) Ausgangslage heraus.

Benefits

🎁 Was wir dir bieten:

Vergütung & Work-Life-Balance:

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr
  • 2 zusätzliche Feiertage (24.12, 31.12)
  • Großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget
  • Ausgefallene Teamevents
  • Innovatives Benefit-Programm

Kommunikation & Vertrauen:

  • Eine offene, ehrliche und direkte Kommunikation. Deine Ideen sind willkommen!
  • Ein Feedbackgespräch jedes Quartals, um gemeinsam zu wachsen.

Modernes Arbeiten:

  • Alles, was du für deinen Arbeitsalltag brauchst: MacBook, Kopfhörer, u.v.m.
  • Ein modernes und inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in Berlin oder in Konstanz am Bodensee.

Individuelle Weiterbildung:

  • Ein Weiterbildungs-Tag pro Monat und ein großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget für deine persönliche Entwicklung.

Buddy-Programm:

  • Ein erfahrener Teamkollege begleitet dich von Anfang an, um dir bei deinem Einstieg zu helfen.

Das Team

  • Wir sind ein bunt gemixter Haufen aus unterschiedlichen Nationen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen. Wir unterscheiden nicht nach Religion, Geschlecht, Alter, Familienstand… . Für uns steht im Mittelpunkt was du kannst!

🪴Unsere Werte:

MAKE IT HAPPEN 💪🏼

  • Ergebnisse erzielen – Übernimm Verantwortung für Problem, Ziel und Ergebnis durch Selbstorganisation und datenbasierte Entscheidungen.
  • Mutig sprechen – Fordere Ideen heraus und nenne Probleme direkt, wenn es drauf ankommt.
  • Dinge erledigen – Sei pragmatisch, halte den Schwung und bringe Energie rein.
  • Wertvolle Wirkung erzeugen – Stelle Lösungen bereit, die unsere Mission und strategischen Ziele vorantreiben.

WIN TOGETHER 💚

  • Offen und respektvoll kommunizieren – Sei transparent, gehe von guten Absichten aus und stelle dein Ego zurück, wenn du mit anderen interagierst.
  • Anderen zum Erfolg verhelfen – Teile proaktiv Wissen, Zeit und Stärken in interdisziplinären Teams.
  • Über Kulturen hinweg arbeiten – Lerne aus diversen Perspektiven und passe deinen Stil aktiv an, um vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit in diversen Teams zu ermöglichen.
  • Teamgeist wecken – Schaffe Momente der Freude und Verbundenheit, die zu großen Erfolgen führen.

SHAPE THE FUTURE 🚀

  • Experimentieren, um zu lernen – Führe Tests durch, messe Ergebnisse, behandle Fehler als Lernchance und setze Erkenntnisse um.
  • Chancen erkennen – Bleib nah am Kunden und Markttrends, um das Nächste zu identifizieren.
  • Nutzerzentrierte Innovation bauen – Nutze zuverlässige, datenbasierte Lösungen und Services, die den Maßstab setzen.
  • Dich selbst weiterentwickeln – Hinterfrage deine Arbeitsweise, hole Feedback ein und baue deine Fähigkeiten aus.

Klingt nach dir? Las uns kennenlernen!

title: Customer Success Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Payflows
description_html:
AI is rewriting how enterprises run. Payflows is the platform making it happen.

The world’s largest companies are held back by complexity — disconnected systems, slow approvals, and manual workflows across Finance, Procurement, and Operations.

Payflows is building the agentic platform for enterprise finance team — where AI agents handle the repetitive work so every process, person, and system so work just flows. Approvals route automatically, payments execute intelligently, and leaders gain real-time visibility into how, when, and why payments are made.

In a world where speed, control, and intelligence define competitive advantage, Payflows enables global enterprises to operate with precision — powered by AI.

One intelligent platform, endless possibilities.

The Role

You’ll be part of the team ensuring our customers get maximum value from Payflows — driving adoption, satisfaction, and long-term success.

As a Customer Success Specialist, you’ll support strategic accounts, strengthen relationships, and help identify growth opportunities. You’ll learn from experienced CSMs, gain exposure to enterprise clients, and develop into a trusted partner for our customers.

This is a career-launching role for someone who’s ambitious, structured, and eager to learn how world-class customer success is done.

Your Mission

Drive Adoption

  • Guide users through best practices and help them unlock the full potential of Payflows.

  • Support onboarding and ongoing enablement efforts to ensure customers succeed.

Build Relationships

  • Engage with customer teams regularly, providing proactive support and ensuring satisfaction.

  • Be the first point of contact for daily questions, feedback, and feature requests.

Support Retention and Growth

  • Collaborate with CSMs to identify opportunities for upsell or deeper adoption.

  • Track account health and surface insights that help customers see measurable ROI.

Collaborate Internally

  • Partner with Product, Implementation, and Growth teams to ensure feedback loops are tight and customer needs are met.

  • Contribute to playbooks and best practices that help scale success across the organisation.

Learn and Grow Fast

  • Build deep product knowledge and SaaS success fundamentals.

  • Develop the skills to progress into a full Customer Success Manager role.


Who You Are

  • You’re a recent graduate or have 1–2 years of experience in SaaS, consulting, or customer-facing roles.

  • You’re structured, analytical, and curious — always asking “how can we make this better?”

  • You’re a natural communicator who builds rapport easily and communicates clearly.

  • You’re eager to work directly with customers and make an immediate impact.

  • You’re passionate about the intersection of finance, technology, and AI, and you want to help shape how enterprises work.

  • You’re proactive, reliable, and thrive in fast-paced environments where ownership comes early.

  • You’re fluent in English (French is a plus).

Your Skills

  • Strong academic foundation in business, economics, finance, or engineering.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills — confident in customer-facing interactions.

  • Organised and process-driven — you love creating structure and clarity.

  • Comfortable with tools like Notion, HubSpot, and Excel, and quick to learn new ones.

  • Strong sense of accountability — you take ownership and deliver results.

  • A fast learner with a passion for building strong relationships and understanding customer needs.

Our Non-Negotiables

Resilience — We’re on a multi-decade mission to reinvent enterprise finance. You embrace challenges, adapt fast, and learn through adversity.
Hunger — You push yourself to grow every day, raising the bar for yourself and those around you.
Trustworthiness — You take ownership, communicate openly, and get it done with integrity and consistency.

This isn’t a customer support job.
It’s a launchpad for the next generation of Customer Success leaders.

If you’re hungry to learn, build relationships, and make an impact from day one — welcome to Payflows.
