salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Payflows
description_html:
AI is rewriting how enterprises run. Payflows is the platform making it happen.

The world’s largest companies are held back by complexity — disconnected systems, slow approvals, and manual workflows across Finance, Procurement, and Operations.

Payflows is building the AI-native Finance OS for enterprise — connecting every process, person, and system so work just flows. Approvals route automatically, payments execute intelligently, and leaders gain real-time visibility into how, when, and why payments are made.

In a world where speed, control, and intelligence define competitive advantage, Payflows enables global enterprises to operate with precision — powered by AI.
One intelligent platform, endless possibilities.

The Role

You’ll be at the centre of how Payflows builds long-term customer partnerships — ensuring our clients not only succeed on our platform but expand with us.

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll own relationships with enterprise finance teams — helping CFOs, Treasurers, and Procurement leaders achieve measurable results. You’ll drive adoption, unlock value, and identify opportunities to grow Payflows’ footprint within each account.

This is a role for someone who combines strategic thinking, relationship mastery, and commercial acumen — someone who thrives on impact, influence, and excellence.

Your Mission

Drive Adoption and Value

  • Partner with customers to deeply understand their objectives and translate them into success plans.

  • Ensure full adoption of Payflows’ platform across Finance, Treasury, and Procurement teams.

  • Deliver measurable outcomes that demonstrate business impact.

Build and Strengthen Relationships

  • Develop deep, trusted relationships with key decision-makers — from operational users to CFO-level stakeholders.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally, championing their needs and feedback across Product and Engineering.

Retain and Expand Accounts

  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities by aligning Payflows’ capabilities with evolving customer goals.

  • Collaborate with Sales to execute account expansion strategies and renewals.

Operate with Precision

  • Monitor account health metrics, anticipate risks, and drive proactive engagement.

  • Maintain operational excellence through structured processes, documentation, and forecasting.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Partner with Product, Implementation, and Growth to ensure alignment, fast issue resolution, and seamless customer experience.


Who You Are

  • You have 2–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Consulting — ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech.

  • You’re a relationship builder — empathetic, curious, and trusted by executives and operators alike.

  • You’re commercially savvy — you understand how to identify business value, articulate ROI, and drive expansion.

  • You thrive in high-performance environments, balancing strategic thinking with operational execution.

  • You’re data-driven — comfortable interpreting usage metrics, identifying risks, and designing playbooks for retention and growth.

  • You communicate with precision — concise, confident, and customer-centric.

  • You’re fluent in English (French is a plus).

Your Skills

  • Proven track record managing or enterprise SaaS accounts, driving adoption and expansion.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills — from onboarding to QBRs.

  • Strong analytical mindset — able to interpret data and make decisions that improve customer outcomes.

  • Experience building and executing account success plans tied to measurable KPIs.

  • Passion for SaaS, finance, and automation — you want to help modern CFOs and Treasurers succeed.

  • Ownership mentality — you don’t wait for direction, you act on insight.

Our Non-Negotiables

Resilience — We’re on a multi-decade mission to reinvent enterprise finance. You embrace challenges and thrive in the fight.
Hunger — You push yourself (and the company) to raise the bar and maximise impact.
Trustworthiness — You take ownership, solve problems, and get it done with integrity and consistency.

This isn’t a support role — it’s a performance role.
If you’re hungry to build relationships that drive real business impact, welcome to Payflows.

title: Project Manager – Service & Maintenance (Southern Europe)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at HoSt Group Bioenergy Systems
description_html:
You take ownership of service operations across Southern Europe and ensure the performance and reliability of advanced energy installations.

About the role

At HoSt Group, you join our team in France, based in our new office in Rennes, and work on projects across France, Spain and Italy collaborating with clients and technical teams in an international environment.

As a Project Manager Service & Maintenance, you play a key role in keeping our biogas and CO₂ recovery installations running safely, efficiently, and in line with service agreements.

In this role, you coordinate service activities across multiple countries, working closely with clients, technicians, suppliers, and subcontractors while building strong relationships. You take a hands-on approach: you monitor performance, lead preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance, and continuously look for ways to improve reliability and reduce downtime.

Your responsibilities

  • Actively identifying commercial opportunities;

  • Preparing quotations and contracts;

  • Performing cost calculations (maintenance contracts versus refurbishment projects);

  • Supervising work execution according to applicable quality, HSE, and safety standards;

  • Identifying and reporting unsafe situations;

  • Selecting external resources and contractors;

  • Invoicing completed work;

  • Monitoring project progress and providing periodic reports;

  • Processing maintenance reports;

  • Optimizing processes and increasing efficiency and effectiveness.


Our requirements

  • Bachelor’s level of working and thinking, preferably in Mechanical Engineering or similar;

  • At least 2 years of experience in a similar role;

  • Affinity with maintenance of (sustainable) installations;

  • Strong safety awareness and good communication skills;

  • Proficiency in French and English; Spanish or Italian are a plus;

  • Knowledge of MS Office and maintenance management systems.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary aligned with your experience and background;

  • Company car;

  • Full-time position (40 hours per week);

  • Hybrid working options with flexibility to work remotely;

  • The opportunity to work for a market leader in sustainable energy, with a strong focus on innovation (winner of the 2024 Oryx and Gazelle awards);

  • An international, family-owned company where your ideas are valued and successes are shared;

  • A collaborative team of both junior and senior professionals;

  • A high level of autonomy, ownership, and responsibility in your role;

  • Strong opportunities for both technical and professional development.

Interested or more information’s?

Click the apply button bellow and start your new challenge!

Want to know more?

Contact; Director- Michael Ghezzi on +33 6 11 14 07 27 or our Corporate Recruiter - Natalia Wisniewska on +31  6 21 30 02 81 .

title: Social-Media Werkstudentin (m/w/d) für Mainwebsolutions & Closery, Würzburg vor Ort
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Mainwebsolutions
description_html:
Du hast richtig Lust, Social-Media-Accounts eigenständig zu übernehmen und wachsen zu lassen? Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera, drehst Reels, hast Ideen im Kopf, bevor jemand danach fragt, und begeisterst dich für KI- und Digitalthemen? Dann suchen wir genau dich: Als Werkstudentin (m/w/d) übernimmst du bei uns die Social-Media-Betreuung von zwei Marken, Mainwebsolutions und Closery, und baust gemeinsam mit den Gründern ein eigenes Podcast-Format auf. Bewirb dich jetzt auf eine Werkstudierendenstelle mit echter Verantwortung.

Was erwartet dich bei uns?

Willkommen bei Mainwebsolutions, der Agentur, die Softwareentwicklung und Onlinemarketing auf ein neues Level hebt! Unser Team besteht aus talentierten Marketern und Entwicklern, die gemeinsam durchstarten. Mit Closery, unserer Voice-AI-Plattform für Shopify und E-Commerce, bauen wir zudem ein eigenes SaaS-Produkt auf, das du auf Social Media von Tag eins an mitprägst. Jeder Tag beginnt mit einer ordentlichen Portion Humor und einem morgendlichen Meeting, in dem wir einander über aktuelle Themen und Fortschritte informieren. Anschließend tauchen wir in die Projekte ein und arbeiten gemeinsam daran, den Erfolg unserer Kunden und unserer eigenen Produkte weiter zu steigern. Doch bei uns geht es nicht nur um Arbeit! Wir feiern unsere Erfolge regelmäßig mit coolen Teamevents. Von Grillpartys auf der Dachterrasse bis zu geselligen Weinfesten, jeder kann sich an unseren Aktivitäten beteiligen. Eines ist sicher: Bei uns steht das Team an erster Stelle. Erlebe den Spirit von Mainwebsolutions! #workatmws

Dein Aufgabenbereich?

Du übernimmst die Social-Media-Accounts von Mainwebsolutions und Closery autark, also von der Idee über die Umsetzung bis zur Analyse. Du entwickelst eigenständig Content-Ideen und Formate, planst deine Beiträge selbst und sorgst dafür, dass beide Accounts auf Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok und Co. sichtbar wachsen. Dabei stehst du selbst vor der Kamera: Du drehst Reels, sprichst in kurzen Videos über KI-, Digital- und E-Commerce-Themen und gibst unseren Marken ein Gesicht. Gemeinsam mit den Geschäftsführern beider Brands baust du ein kleines Podcast-Format auf, begleitest die Aufnahmen, schneidest die Folgen und verwertest sie als Clips für Social Media. Du beobachtest Trends, testest neue Formate und leitest aus den Zahlen ab, was funktioniert und was nicht. Vorgaben brauchst du dafür keine, du bringst die Ideen mit und setzt sie um.



Das bringst du mit:

  • Lust auf eigene Accounts: Du willst nicht nur zuarbeiten, sondern Social-Media-Kanäle eigenverantwortlich führen und sichtbar wachsen lassen.

  • Keine Kamerascheu: Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera, drehst Reels, sprichst frei in Videos und hast Lust, in einem Podcast-Format mit unseren Geschäftsführern mitzuwirken.

  • Begeisterung für KI- und Digitalthemen: Künstliche Intelligenz, Automatisierung, E-Commerce und Onlinemarketing interessieren dich wirklich, und du kannst diese Themen verständlich und unterhaltsam erzählen.

  • Selbstständigkeit und Eigeninitiative: Du generierst eigene Ideen, planst deinen Content selbst und brauchst keine Vorgaben, um loszulegen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Social-Media-Plattformen: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn und Co. sind dir vertraut, und du verstehst, welche Inhalte dort funktionieren.

  • Grundkenntnisse im Videoschnitt: Du musst kein Video-Profi sein, aber du kannst ein Reel oder eine Podcast-Folge mit Tools wie CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbarer Software schneiden oder hast Lust, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Trendgespür und Teamgeist: Du erkennst Trends früh, bist offen für Feedback und hast Spaß daran, in einem dynamischen Team etwas aufzubauen.


Das bieten wir:

  • Sicherer und langfristiger Arbeitsplatz: Wir legen großen Wert auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit. Unser Ziel ist es, jede Person, die wir einstellen, individuell zu fördern und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zu bieten, damit du gemeinsam mit uns wachsen kannst.

  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Unser gemeinsames Ziel ist sowohl die persönliche Weiterentwicklung als auch das Erreichen unserer Firmenziele. Hierfür ziehen wir alle an einem Strang!

  • Team Family: Flache Hierarchien, eine offene Feedbackkultur und regelmäßige gemeinsame Teamevents, die du nicht verpassen solltest. Wenn du Full-Remote für uns arbeitest und an einem Teamevent teilnehmen möchtest, übernehmen wir selbstverständlich Transfer- und Hotelkosten für dich.

  • Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten: In kaum einer Branche ist die Weiterentwicklung der Mitarbeiter so wichtig, wie in der Digitalbranche. Neben der Möglichkeit der Absolvierung verschiedener Zertifizierungen nehmen wir sowohl an Online- als auch an Offline-Events mit unserem Team teil. Hierfür steht dir jährlich 1.500€ Weiterentwicklungsbudget zur Verfügung.

  • Persönliche Entwicklung und Wachstum: Wir unterstützen dich aktiv dabei, deine beruflichen Ziele zu erreichen und dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Leistungen werden anerkannt, und es bestehen Möglichkeiten für Beförderungen im Rahmen deiner Entwicklung.

Benefits

  • Attraktive und leistungsgerechte Vergütung mit langfristiger Perspektive.

  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur und echtes Teamgefühl.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und gemeinsame Aktivitäten.
  • Flexibles Arbeitsumfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung.
  • Zusätzliche Benefits und attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile.

  • Du begleitest nationale und internationale Kunden bei Einführungs-, Transformations- und Betreuungsprojekten.
  • Du berätst bei der Auswahl, Konzeption und Umsetzung zukunftsfähiger Lager- und Logistiklösungen.
  • Du führst Customizing-Anpassungen durch und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungsansätze für komplexe Anforderungen.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete oder Teilprojekte und steuerst diese eigenständig.
  • Du wirkst aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung von Methoden, Standards und innovativen Technologien mit.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im SAP EWM-Umfeld, idealerweise in einer Beratung oder projektorientierten Rolle.
  • Praxis in der Umsetzung von Implementierungsprojekten und im SAP Customizing.
  • Verständnis für logistische Prozesse sowie deren digitale Abbildung in SAP-Systemen.
  • Analytisches Denkvermögen und Freude an der Entwicklung pragmatischer Lösungen.
  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse im Lesen, Analysieren oder Debuggen von Code.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und ein sicheres Auftreten im Kundenumfeld.
  • Offenheit für neue Technologien sowie die Bereitschaft, dich fachlich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft für wichtige Projektphasen beim Kunden.


Benefits

  • Remote-First-Kultur mit hoher Flexibilität für deinen Arbeitsalltag.
  • Individuelle Karrierewege vom Fachexperten bis zur Führungsrolle.
  • Innovative SAP-Projekte mit modernen Technologien und spannenden Kunden.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle in Voll- oder Teilzeit.
  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket aus Fixgehalt und leistungsorientierter Komponente.
  • Workation-Möglichkeiten, damit Arbeit und Ortsunabhängigkeit zusammenpassen.
  • Moderne Mobilitätsangebote rund um Fahrrad, Bahn und nachhaltige Fortbewegung.
  • Zusätzliche Benefits wie Sportangebote und Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge.

description_html:
E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we’re on a mission to change that.

We help brands by democratizing best-in-class operations: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience.

Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 500+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa. With 110+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 9 warehouses across Europe, we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, and greener.

Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward ambitious enterprise expansion.

The journey ahead is bold, and we’re looking for the right partner to help us lead the way.

 

About The Role 🚀

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for retaining and growing Bigblue’s key accounts — some of the most promising European D2C brands — and play a central role in their success.

Location: Paris 9th, France (Hybrid)

As an Account Manager, you will:

  • Build strong, long-term partnerships
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic merchant accounts
  • Act as a trusted advisor by connecting operational topics (service, cost, performance) to business impact
  • Define improvement plans with merchants based on data analysis
  • Identify new partnership opportunities and define improvement plans with merchants
  • Deliver customer excellence
  • Support stakeholders in their day-to-day use of Bigblue’s services
  • Monitor customer feedback and performance trends, and translate them into actionable improvements
  • Contribute to product and operational improvements based on merchant insights and market trends
  • Optimize internal processes and tools to improve the overall customer experience
  • Grow hand-in-hand
  • Contribute to our merchants’ strategic development and identify their metrics that drive growth
  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them
  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing merchants
  • Lead cross-selling and upselling efforts to address customer needs and unlock value

    • You would be a great fit if this sounds like you:
  • You have +5 years of experience in a customer-facing role with regular stakeholder interactions
  • You have a native level of French and professional working proficiency in English
  • You have a growth mindset and are eager to build a strong understanding of the logistics market
  • You are comfortable analyzing data and presenting insights during business reviews
  • You have solid Excel skills
  • You are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris

    • And you also:

  • Have strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • Are analytical and able to leverage data to drive decisions
  • Can solve complex problems and prioritize effectively
  • Demonstrate business acumen and strategic thinking (growing with experience)
  • Are comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously
  • Are proactive, autonomous, and adaptable

    • Bonus points for 🥇
  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit
  • You're passionate about digital and making life simpler with technology
  • You like solving new problems and are never settling for how something "has always been done"
  • You speak another language (Spanish, German

    *It is nice to have a previous experience in logistics, DTC or any industry linked to e-commerce (but definitely not a must-have !)

    • Why join Bigblue
  • 💼 High impact role: Be at the center of our growth journey and help shape the team that will power Bigblue’s future.
  • 💙 Founders-led company with an innovative, caring culture.
  • 🚀 Fast-growing scale-up: Join a well-funded, early-stage company where your work will have immediate and visible results.
  • 🌍 International environment: Work across Paris, Madrid, London, and our European warehouse network.
  • 🏢 Brand-new offices in the heart of Paris’ 9th arrondissement (biggest tech hub).
  • 🍱 10€ meal voucher per worked day (55% paid by Bigblue) + unlimited free snacks at the office.
  • 🧘‍♀️ ClassPass membership for fitness & wellness.
  • 🖥️ MacBook or any setup you need — your choice of equipment to do your best work.
  • 🩺 100% health insurance coverage with Benefiz.

About the Role

As Head of AI Enablement, you will help Bigblue become the most productive commerce operations company in Europe through AI. Your job is not just to raise AI usage across the business — it is to instill an AI-first mindset, so that every team develops a muscle for reaching for new AI capabilities instinctively, and is enabled to act on those instincts.

This role sits at the intersection of internal transformation and external impact. The AI systems and workflows you build internally are increasingly becoming part of Bigblue's external story — shaping how we serve merchants, how our agents engage with them in-product, and how we turn our own operational learnings into time and money saved for the 600+ brands we serve.

You will work across disciplines as part builder, part data expert, part product manager, and part business-ops maven, co-developing the cutting edge of AI tooling for the Bigblue team and using it to drive massive change at high velocity. Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we're scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward ambitious enterprise expansion. The journey ahead is bold, and we're looking for the right partner to help us lead the way.

📊 What data means for Bigblue

At Bigblue, data is the backbone of how we operate. Our data infrastructure — built on BigQuery and dbt, surfaced through Metabase — powers every operational decision: from tracking fulfillment performance across 7 warehouses to monitoring carrier service rates in real time. As we scale across Europe, our BI layer needs to scale with us.

The Ops Excellence team is at the heart of this challenge: translating raw warehouse and transportation data into reliable, structured, and accessible intelligence — so our operators, product teams, and executives can act fast and act right.


🚀 The role

Location: Paris — 7 rue Caumartin, 75009

Type: End-of-studies internship or gap year (SFE / césure)

Duration: 6 months

Start: ASAP

Bigblue is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer Intern to join the Ops Excellence team.

This is a highly technical role at the intersection of data engineering and analytics. You won't just consume data — you'll help build the infrastructure that makes it accessible, reliable, and actionable for our entire Ops organization. This is a unique opportunity to work on real-scale, production-grade BI systems in a fast-moving logistics startup.


✍️ Our data challenges
  • Data pipeline development: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that consolidate and transform raw warehouse and operational data into clean, structured datasets ready for analysis — using SQL, dbt, and our BigQuery data warehouse.
  • Dashboard & reporting infrastructure: Develop scalable BI solutions — datasets, reports, and Metabase dashboards — that give our Ops teams real-time visibility into fulfillment KPIs, warehouse performance, and service levels.
  • Data modeling & schema design: Create and manage data structures that are robust, well-documented, and easy for analysts across teams to use — applying best practices in schema design and data governance.
  • Automation & process improvement: Write secure, maintainable code that automates recurring reporting tasks and frees our analysts to focus on higher-value work. Identify opportunities to replace manual processes with scalable, engineered solutions.
  • Data quality & reliability: Troubleshoot data and pipeline issues, propose solutions, and take ownership of resolutions — ensuring that the numbers our teams rely on are always accurate and up to date.

    • 🙌 Your profile
  • Student in year 4 or 5 of an engineering school, computer science, statistics, or equivalent program
  • Strong SQL skills — able to write complex queries, optimize for performance, and model data from scratch
  • Familiarity with data engineering tools and concepts: dbt, BigQuery, ETL pipelines, data modeling
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, or similar)
  • Python or another scripting language is a strong plus
  • You think in terms of systems: you care about code quality, reusability, and long-term maintainability
  • Curious and rigorous — you go deep to understand the data before trusting it
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, startup environment with evolving requirements
  • Fluency in English and French

    • 🎁 What we offer
  • 🍽️ Meal: €5 per working day (100% tax-exempt) + free meals at the office twice a week
  • 🐻 Health: Alan health insurance, 100% covered
  • 🚲 Transportation: Swile card with €42.50/month for transport
  • 🛍️ "Buy from our merchants" program: birthday, anniversary & end-of-year gifts from Bigblue brands
  • 💰 Compensation: €1,000/month
  • Brand new offices in Paris' largest tech hub (9th arrondissement)
  • MacBooks as standard, plus any equipment you need to do your best work

title: Head of Marketing & Lead Generation

description_html:
Who are we?

moka.care is a mental health solution for companies, with one mission in mind: nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations.

We guide employees through individual and group therapy or coaching sessions.

Alongside we help HR teams to take care of their employees’ mental health on a daily basis.

Where we are currently: Since our creation in December 2019, more than 400 companies (L'Oreal, Spendesk, Qonto, Engie, Castalie, etc.) have joined moka.care, and we now have over 300,000 employees covered in France but also throughout the world!

We have raised 17,5 million euros and are 70 to help companies improve their mental well-being.

What we believe in? Excellence in care is our obsession.

Culture is not nice words we put on the walls, we have defined 4 tangible values to make this culture live: Team Play, Optimism, Ownership & Agility.


Why do we need you?

Moka.Care has built strong foundations in a rapidly evolving market. We are now looking for a marketing leader who can scale our growth and pipeline generation efforts, strengthen our commercial execution, improve go-to-market effectiveness and continue building a leading brand for HR and People teams.

Reporting to Guillaume d’Ayguesvives, co-founder, you will own Moka.Care’s global marketing strategy with a strong focus on pipeline generation, revenue impact and commercial performance.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of 8 people organized across three main areas:

  • Brand, Awareness & Customer Enablement, led by a Brand & Product Marketing Lead
  • Lead Generation, Content & Sales Enablement
  • BDR Team, led by a BDR Team Lead

You will also work closely with the Revenue Operations team to ensure strong alignment between marketing performance, pipeline generation and revenue outcomes.

This role is designed for a performance-oriented marketing leader who combines strategic vision with operational excellence, and who knows how to build scalable growth systems in B2B environments.

What will you do?

Lead a high-performing marketing organization

  • Provide clear direction, prioritization and performance management across the team
  • Coach and develop managers and senior contributors
  • Stay closely involved in execution, funnel performance and operational priorities
  • Strengthen collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Customer, Product, Tech and Revenue Operations teams

Lead Moka.Care’s growth and pipeline generation

  • Define Moka.Care’s growth and lead generation priorities across inbound, outbound, paid acquisition and lifecycle marketing
  • Scale a predictable and efficient pipeline generation engine aligned with revenue objectives
  • Improve acquisition efficiency, funnel conversion and channel performance
  • Partner closely with Revenue Operations to strengthen marketing performance measurement, attribution and budget allocation decisions
  • Strengthen alignment and operating rhythms between Marketing, BDR and Sales teams
  • Lead and develop the BDR Team Lead to maximize outbound pipeline generation and performance

Drive commercial positioning & go-to-market effectiveness

  • Partner closely with Brand & Product Marketing Lead to ensure Moka.Care’s positioning and messaging effectively support pipeline generation and revenue objectives
  • Improve go-to-market effectiveness by strengthening the connection between marketing initiatives, commercial priorities and sales execution
  • Guide segmentation, market expansion and strategic growth initiatives
  • Ensure strong alignment between positioning, messaging and commercial strategy
  • Contribute to maximizing the commercial impact of new offers, campaigns and strategic initiatives

Act as a strategic thinking partner to our Brand & Product Marketing Lead to

  • Support thought leadership through public-facing opportunities and by building relationships with key influencers (HR leaders, scientific experts, industry communities, etc.)
  • Support brand awareness initiatives with creative campaign ideas and strong narratives
  • Protect consistency across brand, content and communication initiatives

You’re the ideal person if

  • You have 8+ years of experience in B2B marketing, including leadership roles (ideally marketing to HR and People Teams as core target personas)
  • You have a strong track record in demand generation, pipeline creation and revenue-focused marketing
  • You have experience leading or working closely with BDR/SDR teams and outbound pipeline generation
  • You are highly data-driven and comfortable working closely with funnel performance and GTM metrics
  • You combine strategic thinking with a strong operational mindset
  • You also have a strong brand sensibility and understand the importance of positioning and messaging
  • You know how to build strong alignment between Marketing, BDR, Sales and Revenue Operations teams
  • You are fluent in both French and English

Joining us you will

  • Participate in an entrepreneurial fast-growing adventure and the possibility of having a huge potential for evolution inside moka
  • See the concrete impact of your efforts each day and participate in nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations
  • Grow as a person and learn within a team of great people
  • Be trusted: we hire great talents who lead us to the next level

We'll take care of you

  • Access to Moka.Care: selfcare, individual & group sessions, and the possibility to test the new features in preview
  • Benefit Fund - May : up to 1500€ net / year (125€ net / month)
  • BSPCE for everyone
  • Work life balance: 60% at the office - 2 days per week or 1 week per month remotely
  • Swile Meal voucher card of 10€/day (restaurants, groceries and food apps)
  • Gymlib for sport & wellness allowance
  • Transportation allowance (50% reimbursed)
  • 7 week holiday policy (& one additional day off per year)

Interview Process

  • Phone interview 
  • Background Interview
  • A Case study and job focused interview to project yourself in your future day-to-day job
  • And finally a Value fit interview to make sure you’ll feel comfortable at moka
  • Offer and reverse interview
If needed we organize other informal talks like coffee with the team.
 
Moka.Care is a disability-friendly company.

title: Growth Marketing Corporate - France

description_html:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Chez Doctrine, on grandit vite. Très vite. De l'organique (nouveaux produits, nouveaux pays) comme de l'externe : 5 boîtes rachetées en 3 ans.
Résultat en 2026 : près de 30 000 clients dans 5 pays : France, Allemagne, Italie, Luxembourg et Espagne. Et sur notre marché historique, la France, on est loin d'avoir fini de jouer.

Doctrine est le leader européen de l'IA juridique. Mais un juriste d'entreprise ne travaille pas comme un avocat, et un dirigeant n'a pas les mêmes attentes qu'un juriste du secteur public.

Le segment Corporate (juristes privés et publics, experts et dirigeants d'entreprises) a ses propres codes, ses propres enjeux. C'est là que tu entres en scène : faire décoller la croissance de Doctrine sur le Corporate France.

Ton objectif n°1 : faire grimper l'ARR de Doctrine sur le segment Corporate en France. Un rôle stratégique, au cœur de la machine Go-to-Market, qui touche tout le funnel : acquisition, activation, rétention (upsell, cross-sell inclus).

L'équipe que tu rejoins

Tu rejoins une équipe Growth de 4 personnes : ton futur manager, deux Growths sur les marchés internationaux et une personne sur le segment Avocat sur le marché français. En face, une vraie force de frappe commerciale que tu vas alimenter au quotidien : 10 BDR, 13 Account Executives et 6 Account Managers. Les leads que tu génères ont donc un terrain de jeu à la hauteur et ton impact se voit vite.

Le point de départ (plutôt sympa 👀)

  • Un modèle SaaS en forte croissance… et rentable (oui, les deux)
  • Un product market fit avec du momentum : près de 30 000 avocats et juristes déjà clients
  • Une équipe Go-to-Market (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) au top pour t'aider à dénicher de nouvelles poches de croissance
  • Une place de leader européen sur une des catégories les plus dynamique au monde : l'IA juridique
  • Une stack à la pointe et une bibliothèque de contenus déjà bien fournie pour dégainer sur les bons leviers et les objections de vente

Tes missions :

Au sein de l'équipe Growth, en collaboration avec les Sales Corporate et l’équipe marketing (PMM, Com, Event) tu passes tes journées à affûter le funnel sur le segment Corporate. Et surtout : tout est challengeable.

  • GTM Synch : animer les points réguliers avec l'équipe Sales Corporate pour définir avec eux, les priorités de campagnes en fonction des besoins terrain. Tu es le trait d'union entre le Growth et les Sales.
  • Outbound Lead Gen : dénicher les bons contacts pour les Sales et lancer les campagnes d'activation (enrichissement, automation, séquences, suivi des perfs).
  • Inbound Lead Gen : Aide au pilotage avec notre agence des campagnes sur Meta, LinkedIn et Google, pour générer un max de leads qualifiés.
  • Nurturing & customer education :
  • Bâtir et faire tourner les campagnes de nurturing sur des leads et contacts,
  • Épauler le Product Marketing sur les lancements produits et les campagnes d’usages à destination de nos utilisateurs,
  • Être le bras droit du marketing sur nos events, webinars et product launches.

    • Le profil qu'on recherche :

    Tu es la personne idéale si tu as envie d’avoir de l’impact, aimes avancer vite et tester de nouvelles approches aussi bien que maintenir des systèmes de campagnes en placer. Et évidemment, tu as à coeur de sortir un copywriting qui poussera à l’action.

    Pour le reste ? Pas besoin d'être un marketeur pur jus. Ops, RevOps, Tech, tous les chemins mènent au Growth. Ce qui compte vraiment : l'envie d'apprendre et de mettre les mains dans le cambouis pour faire grandir Doctrine.

    Hard skills

  • L'IA, c'est ton copilote : ce poste se travaille à 100 % avec l'IA. Production de campagnes, copywriting, analyse, automatisation. Un réflexe quotidien.
  • À l'aise (les mains dedans) sur les outils de marketing automation, sales engagement et CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Intercom, Lemlist…)
  • Tu comprends comment la data circule entre les outils pour créer, challenger et optimiser les parcours clients & prospects
  • Une vraie plume pour le copywriting et l'envie de comprendre ce qui fait vibrer notre cible (juristes, experts, dirigeants)
  • L'envie de construire des stratégies qui durent, pas juste du quick & dirty
  • Un peu d'analytique dans les veines (le SQL est un joli bonus)

    • Soft skills

  • Bon communicant, et tu sais faire parler la data pour trancher
  • Créatif·ve, curieux·se de la psychologie utilisateur pour imaginer des programmes qui marquent
  • Team player : tu navigues dans les équipes transverses et tu comprends les enjeux de chacun pour proposer les meilleurs plans d'action
  • 2 à 3 ans d’expérience, idéalement dans un environnement tech.
  • Maitrise de l’anglais fortement recommandée car régulièrement utilisée en interne

    • Notre stack 🛠️
    Salesforce · HubSpot · Outreach · Intercom · Lemlist · Mixpanel · Google Analytics · Metabase · Zapier/Make

    Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

title: Growth Marketing - Germany 🇩🇪
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Doctrine
description_html:
Our Mission ⚖️

At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.


We grow fast. Really fast. Organically (new products, new countries) and through acquisitions: 5 companies snapped up in 3 years, including a fresh one in Spain. The result in 2026: close to 30,000 customers across 5 countries. The German market? It just blew out its first birthday candle.

Doctrine is the European leader in legal AI. But a German lawyer doesn't work like a French one, and in-house counsel in Berlin don't have quite the same needs as their Paris counterparts. Every market has its own playbook. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive.

 

The team you're joining

A Growth team of 4: your future manager, one Growth on Italy, two on France. We're hunting for the 5th avenger to complete the squad and take full ownership of the German market. On the other side of the table, a team of full-funnel Account Executives ready to turn the leads you generate into wins.

The starting point (pretty sweet, honestly 👀)

  • A high-growth SaaS model, and a profitable one (yes, both)
  • Rock-solid product-market fit with real momentum: close to 30,000 lawyers and legal professionals already on board
  • A top-tier Go-to-Market team (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) to help you uncover new pockets of growth
  • An established spot as the European leader of a category we helped invent: legal AI
  • A cutting-edge tooling stack and a loaded content library to fire on the right levers and shut down objections

Your missions

Inside the Growth team, hand in hand with Sales, PMM and Product, you spend your days sharpening the German funnel, a mix of inbound and outbound. And the best part: everything is open to challenge. Got a better idea? We're all ears.

  • Internationalization: design and roll out local campaigns built for the codes and expectations of the German market (no copy-paste from France).
  • Inbound Lead Gen: team up with our agency to build campaigns that hit hard on Meta, LinkedIn and Google, and pull in as many qualified leads as possible.
  • Outbound Lead Gen: pinpoint the right contacts for the sales teams and fire up activation campaigns (enrichment, automation, sequences, performance tracking).
  • Nurturing: build and run nurturing campaigns on our leads, plus product-usage campaigns with existing customers, to max out conversion and retention.
  • Field Marketing & Product Growth: back the PMM team on product launches and be field marketing's right hand on our events, webinars and product launches.

The profile we're looking for

You're our 5th avenger if you're not afraid to build campaigns day in, day out and copywriting is your thing (better yet, you love it). And, of course: you need to speak German.

For the rest? No need to be a pure-bred marketer. Ops, RevOps, Tech, all roads lead to Growth. What really counts: the drive to learn and to get your hands dirty to help Doctrine grow.

Hard skills

  • AI is your copilot: this role runs 100% with AI, campaign production, copywriting, analysis, automation. A daily reflex, not a gimmick.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation, sales engagement and CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Intercom, Lemlist…).
  • A solid grasp of how data flows between tools, to build, challenge and optimize customer and prospect journeys.
  • A real appetite for copywriting and for understanding what makes our audience tick.
  • A drive to build strategies that last, not just quick & dirty wins.
  • Analytical skills (SQL is a nice bonus).

Soft skills

  • Fluent or native German, non-negotiable: you write and think your campaigns in the language of the market. Professional English also required.
  • Strong communicator who lets the data do the talking when it's time to decide.
  • Creative and curious about user psychology, to design programs that leave a mark.
  • A real team player: you move through cross-functional teams and get everyone's stakes to land the best action plans.

Our stack 🛠️

Salesforce · HubSpot · Outreach · Intercom · Lemlist · Mixpanel · Google Analytics · Metabase · Zapier/Make

What's in it for you ☀️

🏡 A flexible remote work policy, allowing up to three days of remote work per week (depending on your team).

🌴 A flexible leave policy

🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities

🏄‍♂️ Regular team events

📚 A genuine focus on individual and collective learning, with a €750 annual budget for any training related to your role, plus team-wide and company-wide training sessions

🏋️‍♀️ A Gymlib subscription for sports and wellness activities

description_html:
Job Title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
Type: Full-time
Location: Paris 
 
What about us?
 
Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.
 
At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.
 
By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.
 
Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 
 
The Role

We have signed our largest customer to date: a European automotive dealer group operating hundreds of agencies across several countries, with thousands of daily users moving their entire used-vehicle operation onto INFINIT.

As the Enterprise Customer Success Manager — Dealer Groups, based in Paris, you own that relationship. Not as one of ten logos in a portfolio — this is one account, and you go deep into it. You will know their network, their brands, their agency managers and their numbers better than anyone at INFINIT, and you will be the name they think of when they think of us.

The role has two chapters. The first is the migration: you are embedded with the pilot agencies while we tailor the product, and you then own the deployment programme for the whole network — the setup of every agency and the rollout, country by country, on a committed date. Our project leads own the integration and the custom development; getting hundreds of agencies configured, trained and live is yours. The second chapter is the one that lasts: once we are live, this is pure enterprise account management at depth — adoption across thousands of users, the group's commercial results, the renewal, and the expansion of INFINIT across everything else they do.

If your idea of account management is quarterly reviews and a shared inbox, this will not suit you. You will spend real time in dealerships.


What do we want to achieve together?

First chapter — land it (through the migration)

  • Be embedded with the pilot agencies. On site, in the showroom, next to used-vehicle managers, sales advisors and call-centre agents. You learn how they genuinely work — not how it was described in a meeting room — and you make the pilot succeed on their terms.

  • Own the deployment programme. You build and run the rollout plan for hundreds of agencies: sequencing, setup and configuration, user provisioning, training, go-live criteria, hypercare, and the migration tracker the group's leadership reads every week. This is genuine programme ownership — you hold the plan, not someone else's.

  • Lead through the group's regional supervisors. Your closest allies on the ground are the group's regional supervisors — their people, not ours, covering each part of the network. You set the plan, the cadence and the standards with them, and you make the programme theirs to succeed at, in an organisation where nobody reports to you. On our side, you can draw on INFINIT's Operations Agents for setup, configuration and data work.

  • Run the product feedback loop. You are the single channel between the group and our Product & Engineering teams. You separate a genuine platform gap from a habit dressed up as a requirement, write requirements engineers can act on, and hold a prioritised backlog the customer recognises as theirs.

  • Protect the date without breaking trust. Hundreds of agencies migrate inside a single quarter with a hard cut-over. You are the one who sees the risk early, says so, and gets it fixed.

    • Second chapter — grow it (the long game)

  • Drive adoption and value, agency by agency. You track usage across the network, spot the sites that are behind, understand why, and fix it. You know which agencies love us and which ones are quietly not using us — and you never learn that from a dashboard alone.

  • Be the group's business partner, not their vendor contact. You understand their stock turn, their margin per vehicle, their lead conversion. You bring them insight they don't have, and you are credible with agency managers, with the DSI and with general management alike.

  • Own the commercial outcome. Retention and renewal of our largest contract, plus the expansion of INFINIT across the group — above all the deployment of our AI agents into their day-to-day operations.

  • Turn one account into a model. What you learn becomes INFINIT's enterprise dealer-group playbook.


    • What do you need to be successful in this role?

  • 5+ years in enterprise account management in B2B SaaS, owning a small number of large, complex, multi-site customers — not a broad portfolio. You have carried retention and growth on an account that mattered to your company.

  • You have run a multi-site deployment, not inherited one post-go-live. A rollout you personally planned and delivered: the sequencing, the readiness criteria, the training plan, the tracker, the escalation path. We will want the detail — how many sites, what broke, how you held the date.

  • You can lead people who don't report to you. The group's regional supervisors and site managers on one side; INFINIT's Operations Agents, Product and Support teams on the other. You set direction through clarity and credibility rather than authority.

  • Genuinely hands-on. You are comfortable being the most operational person in the room, doing training sessions yourself, sitting with end users for a full day, and being reachable when a site has a problem.

  • Credible in two very different rooms. A technical and contractual conversation with a group IT director, and a full day in a dealership with a used-vehicle manager who has no interest in software. Neither is a performance for you.

  • Product instinct. You are genuinely interested in how the product works, you can arbitrate configuration versus build, and you are comfortable telling a customer no and explaining why.

  • Native-level French and fluent English. A further European language is a strong advantage.

  • Willingness to be in the field. Expect roughly one to two days a week travelling across France during the migration phases, plus regular travel to the group's other European markets, and continued field presence afterwards.

title: Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Genesis
description_html:
About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on.

You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain the end-to-end asset pipeline, from ingestion through to validated output

  • Design agent-driven nodes that generate input content and make decisions inside the graph, with the structured outputs, guardrails and fallbacks that make them dependable in batch

  • Develop automated processing stages: mesh repair, retopology, decimation and LODs, UV unwrapping and texel density normalization, collision proxy generation

  • Derive physical properties so assets behave correctly in simulation: mass, inertia, contact parameters, articulation setup

  • Handle appearance: material conversion to PBR, texture processing, baking, and color management so assets render correctly in Nyx

  • Define and enforce asset standards (units, orientation, pivots, naming, provenance) and build the validators that reject noncompliant assets before they reach the library

  • Scale the pipeline to large batch runs, with caching, versioning and selective reprocessing when a stage changes

  • Build quality checks into the pipeline itself: physics stability harnesses, render smoke tests, automated evaluation of generated content, comparison on reprocessed assets

  • Work with the rendering, physics and research teams on what sim-ready needs to mean for each downstream use

What We're Looking For (ideally)

  • 5+ years building content or asset pipelines in games, VFX, simulation, or 3D tooling, with ownership of a pipeline in production

  • Deep knowledge of 3D asset formats and their quirks: USD, glTF, FBX, OBJ, plus physics description formats such as URDF or MJCF

  • Strong Python and C++ where processing needs to be fast

  • Hands-on mesh processing expertise: remeshing, decimation, UV generation, repair operations, convex decomposition, and a clear sense of how each one fails

  • Solid command of PBR material authoring, texture baking and color spaces

  • Experience driving DCC tools headlessly (Blender, Houdini, Maya) and building batch or distributed job systems around them

  • Practical experience putting LLM or agent calls into production systems: prompting, tool use, structured output, cost and latency control, and handling non-determinism

  • Understanding of what makes an asset physically valid in a simulator: visual versus collision geometry, mass properties, contact behavior, numerical stability

  • Judgment about quality bars, including when an asset is good enough and when it isn't

Nice to Have

  • Experience processing output from generative or reconstruction-based 3D sources, and evaluating that output automatically

  • Agent frameworks, orchestration and eval tooling applied to content generation

  • OpenUSD at scale: composition, layering, MaterialX

  • Semantic annotation and dataset curation at volume

  • Exposure to simulation stacks such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim or similar

title: Integrity Operations Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bumble Inc.
description_html:
Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Integrity Operations Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. Trust and safety are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by supporting members through some of their most sensitive and challenging experiences.

You’ll investigate safety concerns, review accounts and content against Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines, and provide compassionate, trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents. You’ll work across a range of complex and sensitive issues, using established policies, operational guidance, sound judgment, and AI-supported tools to reach fair and consistent outcomes. You’ll also collaborate closely with colleagues across Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, taking ownership of cases and demonstrating our Bumble values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and one another.

This role will be based in the U.S. and will report to the Senior Integrity Operations Manager.

Please note that this position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content.

What you’ll do

  • Investigate and take action on member reports and proactive detections involving safety concerns, including harassment, threats, non-consensual imagery, and other potential violations of Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines.

  • Provide thoughtful, high-touch and trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents, demonstrating Respect and care while following established safety processes.

  • Review accounts and content flagged for potential safety violations, applying policies and operational guidance consistently while using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps.

  • Manage sensitive and time-critical cases with attention to detail, taking ownership of your work and seeing cases through from initial review to an appropriate outcome.

  • Collaborate purposefully with Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, Legal, and other partners to escalate and help resolve cases that require additional expertise or support.

  • Identify recurring issues, patterns, and opportunities to improve workflows, sharing insights that can strengthen operational consistency and member safety.

  • Use AI-supported tools and internal systems to improve efficiency and support decision-making, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before taking action.

  • Participate in on-call rotations, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed, adapting with an agile mindset to support our global community.

About you

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience in Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, content moderation, or another environment where you have handled sensitive or safety-related issues.

  • Are comfortable reviewing potentially distressing content, including material relating to child exploitation, sexual or physical violence, suicide and self-harm, while approaching this work with care and professionalism.

  • Communicate clearly and compassionately in writing and verbally, particularly when supporting vulnerable individuals or navigating sensitive situations.

  • Apply sound judgment within established policies and processes, balancing efficiency with careful, consistent decision-making and demonstrating Bumble’s values of Respect and Excellence.

  • Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your work, and maintain an agile mindset as priorities, cases, and operational needs evolve.

  • Proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another language in addition to English is welcomed but not required.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

About the role

We're looking for an IT Manager to own the day-to-day IT that keeps the company running smoothly and securely as we grow. This covers our people's devices, the office network, the tools everyone uses, and the support they rely on. It's a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving practical problems and making everyday IT work well, reporting into the CIO and based in London.

A big part of the job is security in a practical, operational sense. You'll keep devices patched and well configured, control who has access to what, bring order to the software and accounts that build up as a company grows, and make joining and leaving smooth and secure. You'll operate the controls and standards that the security team sets, and you'll be the person who makes them real in day-to-day work.

You'll work across the whole company, so you'll need to balance keeping people productive with keeping them secure, and be comfortable being the go-to person for anything IT.

Job responsibilities

  • Own endpoint security in practice, including device configuration, patching, controlling local admin rights, and reducing unmanaged software

  • Look after workplace and network security, including the office network and keeping guest and corporate access properly separated

  • Run identity operations day to day, including provisioning, joiner, mover and leaver changes, and regular access reviews

  • Manage software and licensing across the company, and bring order to tools that have crept in without oversight

  • Manage 3rd party vendors such as internet suppliers

  • Look after the office network, devices and everyday hardware

  • Run the IT helpdesk and make sure people get quick, helpful support

About you

Skills, experience and qualifications

  • Experience managing IT operations in a growing company

  • Hands-on with device management and endpoint tooling

About the role

We're looking for someone to build our security operations capability from the ground up. This covers how we spot when something is wrong, how we respond when it is, and how we keep improving both. It's a hands-on leadership role for the early stages, so you'll be setting things up and running them, not managing a large team from day one.

You'll design how we do detection and monitoring for security, decide the right mix of in-house work and outsourced support, and set up how alerts are handled and escalated. You'll also lead how we respond to incidents, working closely with our engineering and reliability colleagues, since a lot of this sits alongside how they already keep our services running.

This is a deeply collaborative role. In particular you'll work hand in hand with our site reliability engineering (SRE) team, since much of security monitoring and response builds on the same tooling and ways of working they already use to keep our services running. We want to avoid heavy, siloed processes and instead build a lean, practical capability that fits how the rest of the business works, bringing in specialist help where it makes sense.

Job responsibilities

  • Decide how much we run ourselves and where we use outsourced monitoring or response, and own that relationship

  • Set up how security alerts are handled, owned and escalated, starting with working-hours coverage

Eine starke IT entsteht dort, wo unterschiedliche Stärken zusammenkommen und gemeinsam pragmatische Lösungen schaffen.

Aufgaben

Infrastruktur & Systeme

  • Sie übernehmen die Verantwortung für die Verwaltung, Betreuung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer gesamten IT-Infrastruktur.
  • Die Administration unserer virtuellen Server-, Host- und VMware-Umgebungen liegt ebenso in Ihrem Aufgabenbereich wie die Betreuung unserer Netzwerk- und Firewall-Infrastruktur auf Basis von Unifi, Aruba und Fortigate.
  • Sie verwalten und überwachen unsere Backupstruktur mit Veeam und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig abgesichert und verfügbar bleiben.
  • Darüber hinaus betreuen Sie unsere Telefonanlage, die Mobilfunkverwaltung sowie weitere zentrale IT-Systeme im Unternehmensalltag.

Modern Workplace & Automatisierung

  • Die Administration unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebung inklusive Intune, Entra ID, Geräteverwaltung, Softwareverwaltung und Mail Security gehört ebenfalls zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich.
  • Sie betreuen unsere Active-Directory-Umgebung, übernehmen die Benutzerverwaltung und stellen sicher, dass Berechtigungen und Gruppenrichtlinien zuverlässig gepflegt werden.
  • Mit Hilfe von PowerShell sowie Power Automate und Power Apps automatisieren Sie Prozesse und tragen dazu bei, Abläufe effizienter und nachhaltiger zu gestalten.
  • Gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen aus unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und innerhalb des IT-Teams entwickeln Sie praxisnahe Lösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag vereinfachen und technische Prozesse verbessern.

Support & Zusammenarbeit

  • Sie arbeiten eng mit Ihren Teamkolleg:innen zusammen, bringen eigene Ideen ein und unterstützen sich gegenseitig bei unterschiedlichen technischen Herausforderungen und Projekten.
  • Sie übernehmen den 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support für unsere Mitarbeitenden, analysieren IT-Störungen und sorgen für schnelle sowie verständliche Lösungen.
  • Dabei helfen Sie Kolleg:innen dabei, sicher und effizient mit Hard- und Software zu arbeiten und stehen bei technischen Fragen unterstützend zur Seite.
  • Sie dokumentieren relevante IT-Prozesse und unterstützen bei der Einführung neuer Systeme und Anwendungen.
  • Darüber hinaus begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende bei Veränderungen im digitalen Arbeitsumfeld und unterstützen dabei, neue Lösungen verständlich und praxisnah im Alltag zu etablieren.

Qualifikation

  • Sie dokumentieren Störungen und Lösungen und helfen dabei, Anleitungen und wiederkehrende Abläufe so festzuhalten, dass sie auch für andere verständlich und nachvollziehbar sind.

Sie suchen eine positive berufliche Veränderung? Sie möchten den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und streben möglicherweise sogar eine Partnerschaft in einer zukunftsorientierten Kanzlei an? Sie möchten endlich wieder in einem positiven Arbeitsumfeld arbeiten, in dem Sie finanziell und persönlich wertgeschätzt werden? Sie suchen nach Tätigkeiten, die Sie auch wirklich weiterbringen?

Sofern Sie sich in mindestens einem der genannten Punkte wiederfinden, sollten Sie sich bei uns melden. Wir haben die attraktivsten Arbeitgeber der Steuerberatungsbranche in unserem Netzwerk und bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Grenzenlose Entwicklungschancen mit Partnermöglichkeiten, vielschichtige Tätigkeitsbereiche, Gehälter wie in der Industrie und vieles mehr – melden Sie sich bei uns und wir unterstützen Sie auf Ihrem weiteren Karriereweg!

Derzeit suchen wir nach einem Steuerberater (m/w/d) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Lieser

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Wir bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Dabei spielt das passende Tätigkeitsprofil natürlich eine entscheidende Rolle. Bei unserer Partnerkanzlei können Sie sich Ihren Aufgabenbereich auf Basis Ihrer persönlichen Stärken und Schwächen selbst zusammenstellen.

  • Erstellung und Review von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von Steuererklärungen für Personen- und Kapitalgesellschaften
  • Steuerliche Sonderberatungsprojekte auf Basis individueller QualifikationenB. in den Bereichen der Erbschaftsteuer oder des Umwandlungssteuerrechts
  • Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen
  • Teamleitung und Personalverantwortung (optional)
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die Ihnen Freude bringen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Führungsverständnis und Verantwortungsbewusstsein gegenüber Mitarbeitern (optional)
  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Sie haben genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen Sie nicht wirklich profitieren? Dann sollten Sie einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung von 90.000 € bis 130.000 € / Jahr, auf Wunsch auch Partnerperspektive
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf Home-Office
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen wie z.B. Fachberater Qualifikationen
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient Ihren Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an Sie, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. lhre Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Sie führen keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen Sie während des Bewerbungsprozesses merken, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor Ihrem Bewerbungsgespräch all Ihre mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen Ihre Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens.
  • 100% Anonymität – solange Sie uns nicht das „Go“ geben und einem Kennenlernen mit Ihrem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmen, erfährt niemand von Ihrem Namen oder Ihren bisherigen Arbeitgebern – Ihre Ihnen wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären.
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.).
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für Sie.

title: Electrician (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sereact GmbH
description_html:
Who We Are:

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can’t solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we’re looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview:

We are looking for a hands-on electrician or automation technician to support the build, installation, and optimization of our robotic systems. You will be responsible for wiring, testing, and commissioning electrical components both in our lab and on-site. You will collaborate closely with mechanical and software teams to ensure seamless system integration, resolve technical issues, and implement improvements across new and existing systems.

Your Responsibilities:

Installation & Integration

  • Build and wire electrical systems for robotic applications, including cabinets and field wiring. 

  • Support system commissioning in the robotics lab and at customer locations.  

  • Work closely with mechanical and software engineers to ensure correct system integration.  

  • Implement technical improvements and modifications based on project feedback.  

  • Diagnose and resolve electrical faults during development and deployment.

Qualifications:

Education and Experience

  • Completed technical training (e.g. State-certified Technician in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or Automation) or a comparable vocational qualification (e.g. Electrician, Control Cabinet Builder, Electrical Master)

  • Certified to perform electrical work (Elektrofachkraft – EFK)

  • Relevant professional experience in automation or robotics preferred

  • Willingness to travel: ≈ 25-50%

Skills

  • Experience with electrical installations, control systems, sensors, and actuators  

  • Hands-on mentality and technical craftsmanship

  • Basic knowledge of EPLAN/Splan is a plus

  • Valid Class B driver’s license (EU)

Our interview plan:

  • Application

  • Take‑home assignment: You’ll work on a short, role‑relevant task with clear instructions and a deadline.

  • Cultural fit interview (40 min): A conversation about how you work, what motivates you, and what you’re looking for. Expect CV highlights, your “why,” and time for your questions.

  • Technical fit interview (45 min): A deeper dive into your skills and problem‑solving approach for this role.

  • On‑site visit: Meet the team in our office and collaborate on a real challenge similar to the work you’d do here. You’ll also meet a founder; we aim to give you a clear feel for the role and environment.

What We Offer:

  • Wellpass (gym membership)  

  • Flexible working hours  

  • Option to work from home when needed  

  • A motivated team and an open corporate culture  

  • Competitive compensation and excellent career development opportunities
