description_html:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Benefits and Perks:
Beyond a stellar work environment, friendly people, and inspiring work, we have some sweet benefits and perks:
 
·       UK Pension Scheme
·       Private medical and dental insurance
·       Health &Wellness Reimbursement Program
·       Unpaid sabbatical leave
·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!

title: Project Manager & Functional Consultant
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at BLP Digital AG
description_html:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

Location

This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich, the role will be based remotely or hybrid from Germany or Austria. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by blp.

 

About the role

As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you'll operate at the intersection of business and tech, leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You'll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.

 

What you'll do

  • Own the implementation journey end-to-end, from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

  • Translate complexity into clarity: design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

  • Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers' unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

  • Be the client's trusted partner: anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp's automation.

  • Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

  • Feed the product loop: surface what isn't working and translate that feedback into long-term platform improvements.

 

What you'll bring

Key attributes for success

  • Ownership and autonomy. You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

  • Managing ambiguity. You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

  • Growth mindset. You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

  • Problem solving and critical thinking. You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

  • Customer-first mentality. You think beyond implementation and care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills: you can translate business needs into technical action.

  • Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

  • Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus.

  • Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

 

What you'll get

  • High ownership environment. You shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale. Your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure. Work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth. Fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership. Be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team. Become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure. Be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits and offsites. Paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Strategic Value Engineer (Presales)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at BLP Digital AG
description_html:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

About the role

We're hiring a Strategic Value Engineer (Presales) to shape and win enterprise ERP automation decisions: you reframe problems, quantify the cost of inaction, and prove value through tailored workshops and demos. Partnering with an AE, you own technical leadership, value articulation, and de-risking security/integration, building alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees.

 

What you'll own

Insight-led discovery and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing, introduce a sharper point of view on where value is actually trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls), and reframe urgency using cost-of-inaction.

  • Lead discovery across CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate that into a crisp target-state narrative and mutual action plan.

Solution design and technical leadership

  • Architect a tailored solution: scope, rollout approach, integration pattern, security posture, and success criteria.

  • Run deep dives with IT/security and articulate how blp works in enterprise environments (ERP digital twin, data synchronization, governance and controls).

Demos, workshops, and executive storytelling

  • Deliver high-impact demos that map to customer workflows (P2P, AP, S2P) and prove outcomes, not features.

  • Facilitate workshops that turn stakeholder skepticism into a tangible blueprint and path to value.

Value engineering (business case support)

  • Build a credible value narrative: labor productivity gains, cycle time reduction, compliance/control improvements, and stack simplification.

  • Support champions and the AE with executive-ready business-case inputs, impact ranges, and rollout economics, flagging risk to the deal early rather than late.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Help the deal team land a clear "why now" anchored in operational risk, ERP program success, and enterprise scale requirements.

 

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 3–8+ years in Value Engineering / Presales / Solution Consulting / ERP process consulting (or equivalent in finance/procurement operations with strong customer-facing chops).

  • Demonstrated ability to run insight-based discovery (Challenger-style): you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and build conviction across a buying committee.

  • Comfort with senior stakeholders (CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services): you can lead without authority.

  • Strong workshop facilitation and demo craft: story, structure, and objection handling.

  • Ability to connect technical realities to business outcomes (FTE capacity, cycle time, controls, compliance risk, TCO).

Strong plus

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

  • Finance/process knowledge: AP, invoice processing, S2P/P2P, exception handling, approvals, master data workflows.

  • Experience competing against legacy vendors and "patchwork stacks."

Language

  • Fluent in English and another major European language, preferably German, depending on territory.

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Verkäufer – Trainer (m/w/d) – Bäckerei Exner

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du die AI-Aktivitäten im deutschen Markt maßgeblich mit. Du arbeitest eng mit Enterprise-Kunden, lokalen Sales-Teams und einer internationalen AI Practice zusammen und führst gleichzeitig ein erfahrenes AI-Team in Deutschland.

• Leitung von AI-Presales-Aktivitäten und strategischen Kundengesprächen
• Entwicklung von AI-, GenAI- und LLM-Lösungen aus konkreten Business-Anforderungen
• Präsentationen, Workshops und Solution Discussions mit Senior- und C-Level-Stakeholdern
• Unterstützung bei Pitches, Proposals, RFPs und Solution Architecture
• Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines erfahrenen AI-Teams
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen AI- und Data-Experten
• Mitgestaltung neuer AI-Angebote, Use Cases und Business Opportunities
• Repräsentation des Unternehmens bei Kunden, Events und Fachveranstaltungen


Fundierte Erfahrung in AI, Machine Learning, GenAI und LLMs
• Erfahrung im Consulting, Presales oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle
• Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Themen in klaren Business Value zu übersetzen
• Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Kunden, idealerweise in Manufacturing, Automotive, Pharma, Retail oder Financial Services
• Leadership-Erfahrung oder ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung
• Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem bzw. nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau
• Professionelles Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen, globalen Umfeld
• Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Kundenterminen und Reisen

Besonders interessant sind Profile aus AI Consulting, Data Science, Solution Architecture, Value Engineering oder AI Practice Leadership.

Gesucht wird keine rein technische Führungskraft, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die AI versteht, Kunden überzeugt und Technologie in konkrete Geschäftsmöglichkeiten übersetzen kann.

description_html:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
As our Head of Supply Chain UK you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do
  • Build and own Hypersonica’s UK supply chain capability from first principles, establishing a secure, resilient, and execution focused procurement function for complex aerospace hardware.
  • Lead sourcing and contracting across long lead, highly regulated propulsion and flight critical subsystems, ensuring schedule integrity under demanding national security constraints.
  • Develop and qualify a trusted supplier network across advanced materials, precision fabrication, high performance electronics, military grade avionics, and specialist manufacturing partners.
  • Negotiate and structure commercial agreements that balance cost, schedule, export controls, and security requirements within a UK defence acquisition environment.
  • Establish supplier onboarding, audit, and performance management frameworks aligned with aerospace quality standards and future AS9100 certification.
  • Work directly with engineering to translate technical requirements into executable procurement strategies, managing configuration changes and rapid iteration without compromising compliance.
  • Build the operational backbone of UK procurement: processes, tools, documentation discipline, and supplier risk management in a fast scaling defence start up.
  • Serve as the primary UK interface for controlled components, export considerations, and sensitive supply chain pathways, ensuring resilience against geopolitical and regulatory disruption.

    • Who you are
  • An experienced aerospace or defence supply chain leader who has owned procurement of complex, high consequence hardware programmes.
  • Comfortable sourcing long lead propulsion adjacent systems, flight critical electronics, and military grade subsystems within tightly controlled regulatory environments.
  • Experienced operating under export control and UK national security frameworks, with strong instincts for compliance and discretion.
  • Proven in building supplier networks from scratch or transforming immature procurement functions into disciplined, scalable systems.
  • Commercially sharp and technically literate, able to challenge engineering assumptions while protecting schedule and cost.
  • Calm under pressure, capable of securing critical supply in constrained markets where availability and reliability matter more than price alone.
  • Energised by building something from nothing in a small, elite team where supply chain performance directly determines mission success.
  • Motivated by sovereign capability and the responsibility that comes with delivering nationally significant defence hardware.

    • What we offer
  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.

    Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.

title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Part-time)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Soda Data Nv
description_html:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice. Accuracy is the bar for both: in finance, 99% right is wrong, so every automation ships with the checks and reconciliations that prove its output.

What You'll Do

  • Run core finance processes: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges. Learn them, run them, own them.
  • Automate them: with Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub and the Soda MCP, or with smart spreadsheet design when that is the better tool.
  • Build in the checks: reconciliations and controls in everything you automate, so the output is verified before anyone else has to look at it.
  • Document as you go: process documentation that a colleague and an AI agent can both follow.
  • Support the wider Finance team: reporting, analysis, and ad-hoc projects across our Belgian and US entities.

Hiring Process

1.      Application with a few short questions

2.      Recorded video interview (3 questions, in your own time)

3.      20-minute interview

4.      Take-home assignment (plan for 5-6 hours)

5.      45-minute deep dive on your assignment

6.      Final interview

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

•     A finance background: studying towards or recently completed a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

•     Proof that you build: you've used AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) and/or built automations, scripts, or advanced spreadsheet solutions, and you can show us one and explain how you checked its output.

•     Accuracy as a habit: you're the person who notices the 780 that should have been 800, and you don't sign off on numbers you haven't verified.

•     Independent with new tools: you can pick up GitHub, MCP-based integrations, and finance systems without a course.

•     Proactive: you spot the manual work and come with a plan for it. You'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.

•     Fluent English, written and spoken.

•     European business hours: fully remote from any compatible time zone, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

Good to Have

•     Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact Online, QuickBooks) or ERP systems.

•     Exposure to Python, SQL, or API-based automation.

•     Prior startup or fast-paced work experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

•     €1,250 - €1,750 per month, depending on experience.

•     A clear path to a permanent role if you perform: 3-month contractor engagement first, extended as it works.

•     Fully remote and flexible working, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

•     All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.

•     Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. This is not a coffee-and-observe internship - you operate as part of the Finance team.

•     Start: As soon as possible, aiming for the beginning of October 2026

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

•     You own processes, not tickets: what you automate is yours to design, and behind it is a list of things nobody here has built yet.

•     Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.

•     Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.

•     International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.

•     Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

•     Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.

•     Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

 

Join us to elevate our finance team to the next level!

Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice. Accuracy is the bar for both: in finance, 99% right is wrong, so every automation ships with the checks and reconciliations that prove its output.

What You'll Do

  • Run core finance processes: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges. Learn them, run them, own them.
  • Automate them: with Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub and the Soda MCP, or with smart spreadsheet design when that is the better tool.
  • Build in the checks: reconciliations and controls in everything you automate, so the output is verified before anyone else has to look at it.
  • Document as you go: process documentation that a colleague and an AI agent can both follow.
  • Support the wider Finance team: reporting, analysis, and ad-hoc projects across our Belgian and US entities.

Hiring Process

1.      Application with a few short questions

2.      Recorded video interview (3 questions, in your own time)

3.      20-minute interview

4.      Take-home assignment (plan for 5-6 hours)

5.      45-minute deep dive on your assignment

6.      Final interview

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

•     A finance background: studying towards or recently completed a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

•     Proof that you build: you've used AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) and/or built automations, scripts, or advanced spreadsheet solutions, and you can show us one and explain how you checked its output.

•     Accuracy as a habit: you're the person who notices the 780 that should have been 800, and you don't sign off on numbers you haven't verified.

•     Independent with new tools: you can pick up GitHub, MCP-based integrations, and finance systems without a course.

•     Proactive: you spot the manual work and come with a plan for it. You'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.

•     Fluent English, written and spoken.

•     European business hours: fully remote from any compatible time zone, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

Good to Have

•     Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact Online, QuickBooks) or ERP systems.

•     Exposure to Python, SQL, or API-based automation.

•     Prior startup or fast-paced work experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

•     €1,250 - €1,750 per month (pro rata of €2,500 - €3,500 for 40H), depending on experience.

•     A clear path to a permanent role if you perform: 3-month contractor engagement first, extended as it works.

•     Fully remote and flexible working, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

•     All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.

•     Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. This is not a coffee-and-observe internship - you operate as part of the Finance team.

•     Start: As soon as possible, aiming for the beginning of October 2026

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

•     You own processes, not tickets: what you automate is yours to design, and behind it is a list of things nobody here has built yet.

•     Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.

•     Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.

•     International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.

•     Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

•     Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.

•     Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

 

Join us to elevate our finance team to the next level!

title: AI Content Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Soda Data Nv
description_html:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own content at Soda, end to end.

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues.

The Role

The website. Technical blogs, webinars, and product videos. Your own content and following.

One person cannot hand-make all of that. So you'll build the system that can. That isn't a stretch goal or a second phase - we don't think the job exists without it.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself. Content engineer, technical content marketer, growth engineer, marketing engineer, GTM engineer, developer advocate, technical writer who got bored, or nothing in particular. We've seen this job posted under every one of those. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to be able to write and you need to be able to build, and almost nobody can do both.

Why this is a real problem and not a content calendar. The expertise is already in the building. Founders who have argued about this category for a decade. Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. Almost none of it gets written down, and what does get out is hand-made, one piece at a time, by people who have other jobs. Your job is to get it out of their heads and onto the internet, at a volume that is only possible with a machine behind it.

Taste is the bar. Anti-slop is the whole point. An engine that ships slop faster has negative value, and most of them do. We're hiring for the judgment to look at an accurate, competent, lifeless draft and bin it - then work out what the pipeline did wrong and fix it. The engine has to write in distinct voices: a founder sounds nothing like a customer engineer, and the output should sound like them, not like a model. Your own profile and following is part of how we'll know it works. If it can't make you sound good, it won't make anyone else sound good either.

What this is not. You'll write code every day, but this is not a software engineering job. We're not hiring you to build product, and if you're a backend, data, or platform engineer looking for your next engineering role, this isn't it. It's also not a traditional marketing or DevRel role: no agency to brief and no conference circuit.

Requirements

  • You can write, and you can tell good writing from bad: send us something you wrote that a technical audience actually read. The most important line in this ad.
  • Serious prompt engineering: multi-step LLM pipelines with structured outputs and evals, not chatting with a model. You know why the naive version produces slop.
  • 3+ years building things that go to market: technical content, growth engineering, marketing engineering, GTM engineering, DevRel, marketing ops, RevOps, or a founder background. Nobody agrees what to call this job yet. Titles vary; portfolios don't.
  • Enough code to be autonomous: Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, a database. Nothing should be blocked waiting for an engineer. We build agentically here - Claude Code, MCP servers, and agent skills are the daily workflow.
  • Enough data fluency to be credible: you're writing for Staff Data Engineers and CDOs. You can hold your own on pipelines, data quality, and warehouses.
  • Generalist instinct: you find the constraint and fix it, and you'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • You've grown a technical audience of your own: newsletter, blog, LinkedIn, open source, YouTube.
  • Content, growth, or DevRel in data, developer tools, or infrastructure.
  • Agentic workflows shipped to real users: MCP servers, Claude skills, tool-using agents.
  • You can shoot and cut video yourself.
  • Data quality, data management, or data observability industry experience.

Benefits

  • Compensation: $120,000-$130,000 / €110,000-€120,000 per year + equity - the same band wherever you live. We don't discount for geography.
  • Fully remote (US or EU-based), with offices in Brooklyn if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • Colleagues in 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.
  • Paid the same wherever you are: one band for the US and Europe, no geographic discount.
  • Your name on the work: you build your own audience on company time, and we want you to.
  • Direct line to the founders: how Soda talks about the category gets decided with you in the room.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.
  • You will kill a lot of your own output: accurate and lifeless still goes in the bin.
  • Judged on output, not architecture: an elegant pipeline nobody reads from is a failure.

Hiring Process

  1. 15-minute phone screen - with a founder
  2. Short Assignment
  3. Craft deep dive (90 min)
  4. Culture fit (1 hour)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

title: Werkstudent:in Retail Expansion / Retail Growth (m/w/d) in Berlin Mitte
description_html:
Dein Impact

Bei Juit ermöglichen wir unseren Kunden, sich jeden Tag gesund zu ernähren, indem wir von Köchen und Köchinnen zubereitete Mahlzeiten direkt nach Hause liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, die Nummer 1 unter den Marken für gesunde Mahlzeiten in Deutschland zu werden, indem wir unseren Kunden das beste Online-, Essens- und Liefererlebnis bieten.

Um unsere Präsenz vor Ort in Berlin Mitte massiv auszubauen und neue Kunden für unsere Marke zu begeistern, suchen wir ab sofort echte Macher (m/w/d) für unser lokales Store-Team.

Du hast Lust auf Start-up-Vibe, liebst den direkten Kundenkontakt und willst aktiv daran mitarbeiten, unseren Store zum Erfolg zu führen? Dann werde Teil unserer Growth-Story!

Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Retail Growth bist du unser Aushängeschild und treibst das lokale Wachstum direkt an der Basis voran. Deine Aufgaben sind ein Mix aus Hands-on-Operations und proaktiver Kundenakquise:

  • Local Marketing & Customer Acquisition: Du bist der Motor für unsere Frequenz im Store! Du gehst charmant und selbstbewusst auf Passanten vor unserem Store zu, machst sie auf unsere Marke aufmerksam und holst sie aktiv auf die Verkaufsfläche.

  • Brand Ambassadorship & Sales: Du bist der erste Touchpoint für unsere Kunden. Du berätst sie mit Begeisterung, beantwortest Fragen und schaffst ein Einkaufserlebnis, das im Gedächtnis bleibt.

  • Store Operations: Wachstum braucht Struktur. Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft, übernimmst den Kassiervorgang und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Waren optimal präsentiert und nachgefüllt sind.

  • Growth Insights: Du bist unser Ohr am Markt! Du sammelst direktes Kundenfeedback und teilst deine Erkenntnisse mit dem Team, um unsere lokale Retail-Strategie stetig zu verbessern.


Deine Stärken

  • Du hast eine offene, mitreißende Persönlichkeit und absolut keine Scheu, fremde Menschen aktiv anzusprechen.

  • „Hands-on“ ist dein zweiter Vorname – du packst gerne mit an und behältst auch an frequenzstarken Tagen den Überblick.

  • Du bist aktuell an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert (ideal, aber kein Muss: Studiengänge wie BWL, Marketing, Kommunikation, Retail Management).

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (weitere Sprachen sind ein großes Plus) und hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Promotion, Sales, Gastronomie oder Retail sind super, aber vor allem zählt deine Motivation!


Unser Versprechen

  • Engagiertes Team mit talentierten und inspirierenden KollegInnen

  • Interessante Tätigkeit in einem wachsenden Unternehmen mit der Chance, sich weiterzuentwickeln

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung und Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an

  • Mitarbeiterrabatt auf unsere Juit Boxen

  • Ein moderner Arbeitsplatz 


Unsere Werte



Jetzt Bewerben!

Du hast Lust, Teil unseres Teams zu sein und die Zukunft von Juit mitzugestalten? Dann bewerbe Dich jetzt bei uns! Wir freuen uns Dich kennenzulernen.

Bitte beachte, dass für alle Bewerbungen eine Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland erforderlich ist!

title: Werkstudent im Bereich Innovation, New Business & Startups (all people)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Leipziger Foren Services GmbH
description_html:
Worum es geht:

  • Du steckst mitten im Studium und möchtest neben der Theorie Einblicke in Innovation, neue Geschäftsmodelle und aktuelle Trends gewinnen?
  • Du hast Spaß daran, dich mit neuen Technologien, Start-ups und Entwicklungen zu beschäftigen und herauszufinden, was davon für die Versicherungswirtschaft relevant werden könnte?
  • Du recherchierst und analysierst gern, denkst kreativ und hast Lust, deine eigenen Ideen und Perspektiven einzubringen?
Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen, um zu schauen, wie du unser Team als Werkstudent:in Innovation, New Business & Startups (all people) mit 15 – 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen kannst!
Wir, die Versicherungsforen Leipzig, unterstützen Unternehmen der Versicherungswirtschaft bei ihren Forschungs- und Entwicklungsvorhaben. Wir erforschen und analysieren neue Trends, erarbeiten daraus konkrete Anforderungen für die Unternehmen und entwickeln gemeinsam Lösungsansätze. Neben Marktanalysen, Studien sowie Strategieberatung sind die Versicherungsforen Leipzig als Anbieter von Aus- und Weiterbildungsformaten wie Seminaren, Fachkonferenzen und Messekongressen bekannt.


Das bewirkst du bei uns:

  • Du wirkst im Tagesgeschäft und in Projekten rund um Innovation & New Business in der Versicherungswirtschaft mit.
  • Du recherchierst und analysierst aktuelle Trends, Technologien, Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Marktentwicklungen und bereitest relevante Impulse für unsere Projekte und Formate auf.
  • Du bringst dich kreativ in die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung neuer Ideen und Formate ein – von der ersten Konzeption bis zur konkreten Umsetzung.
  • Du arbeitest an unserem Trendradar mit, recherchierst und bewertest neue Entwicklungen, bereitest Inhalte auf, führst Plausibilitätschecks durch und erstellst begleitende Unterlagen.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption, Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Workshops, Veranstaltungen und weiteren Austauschformaten und wirkst bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen und Arbeitsmaterialien mit.
  • Du bereitest Erkenntnisse, Trends und Impulse zielgruppengerecht auf und hilfst uns dabei, auch komplexe Themen verständlich und ansprechend für unterschiedliche Kommunikations- und Austauschformate zu vermitteln.
  • Du wirkst aktiv in unserem New Players Network mit und erhältst spannende Einblicke in die Start-up- und InsurTech-Szene. Dabei recherchierst du neue Unternehmen und ihre Geschäftsmodelle, identifizierst interessante New Player, unterstützt die Vernetzung in unserem Start-up-Netzwerk und wirkst bei unseren Pitch- und Austauschformaten mit.


Darum passt du zu uns:

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, hast noch mindestens zwei Semester vor dir und verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.
  • Du interessierst dich für Innovation, neue Technologien, Trends und Geschäftsmodelle und hast Lust, dich mit neuen Themen auseinanderzusetzen.
  • Du recherchierst gern, kannst Informationen strukturiert und verständlich aufbereiten und gehst sicher mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen um.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und sorgfältig, bist neugierig, kreativ und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein.
  • Du interessierst dich für generative KI und hast bereits erste Erfahrungen mit KI-Tools gesammelt.


Was uns verbindet:

Demokratie, Vielfalt und Toleranz sind für uns nicht nur gesellschaftliche Grundwerte, sondern die Basis unseres Miteinanders: Wir stehen für Weltoffenheit, gegenseitigen Respekt und Chancengleichheit und heißen Menschen unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter oder sexueller Identität bei uns willkommen.


Freue dich auf Folgendes:

  • Bei uns kannst du deine Kenntnisse in innovativen Themen vertiefen, eigene Ideen einbringen und deine Fähigkeiten aktiv weiterentwickeln. 
  • Du bekommst Einblicke in verschiedene Themenbereiche und sammelst wertvolle Praxiserfahrung. 
  • Dich erwarten eine lockere Arbeitsatmosphäre, flache Hierarchien und viel Raum für eigenständiges Arbeiten. 
  • Für deine Energie und Konzentration sorgen wir mit einer Kaffee-, Tee- und Wasserflat.
  • Deine Arbeitszeiten und -orte kannst du flexibel an dein Studium anpassen. 
  • Unser modernes Büro liegt zentral in Leipzig und in unmittelbarer Nähe zur Universität. 
  • Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents, Gesundheitsangebote und weitere gemeinsame Aktionen sorgen für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag.


Wie gehts jetzt weiter?

Du fühlst dich angesprochen und möchtest gern mit uns durchstarten? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kleines Motivationsschreiben.

Bei Fragen kannst du dich gerne direkt an unsere Recruiterin Jule wenden – telefonisch unter 0341 98988 123 oder per Mail an .

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Senior Elektroingenieur (m/w/d) – Analogelektronik & Messtechnik
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Empit
description_html:
Deine Mission

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir für unseren Standort Berlin einen erfahrenen Senior Elektroingenieur (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Analogelektronik und Messtechnik, der mit seinem Know-how unsere Mess- und Inspektionstechnologie technisch weiter voranbringt.

EMPIT ist ein wachsendes Deep-Tech-Unternehmen, das Mess- und Inspektionssysteme für den internationalen Einsatz an kritischer Infrastruktur entwickelt. Mit unseren Technologien machen wir sichtbar, was sonst verborgen bleibt, und leisten damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit kritischer Infrastruktur.

In deiner Rolle entwickelst und optimierst du die Elektronik hinter diesen Systemen – von leistungsfähigen Stromversorgungen und Platinen bis hin zur Neukonzeption einzelner Komponenten unserer Signalgeneratoren. Dabei entstehen Lösungen, die kompakt, zuverlässig und für den internationalen Einsatz ausgelegt sind. 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Stromversorgungen weiterentwickeln: Leistungsfähigkeit, Effizienz und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Stromquellen verbessern und auf die Anforderungen unserer Messsysteme abstimmen.
  • Platinen und elektronische Baugruppen entwickeln: Schaltungen aufbauen, Prototypen in Betrieb nehmen, Messergebnisse bewerten und bestehende Hardware gezielt optimieren.
  • Elektronik kompakter machen: Bestehende Baugruppen hinsichtlich Größe, Gewicht und Aufbau optimieren, damit unsere Systeme sicher und effizient transportiert werden können – auch per Flugzeug.
  • Signalgeneratoren neu denken: Bestehende Komponenten analysieren, technische Grenzen hinterfragen und neue Lösungen für unsere Signalgeneratoren und Messsysteme entwickeln.
  • Technische Herausforderungen lösen: Fehler systematisch analysieren, Ursachen identifizieren und eigenständig praxistaugliche Lösungen bis zur Umsetzung bringen.
  • Technologie mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit unserem Team neue Konzepte entwickeln und technische Entscheidungen für die nächste Generation unserer Mess- und Inspektionssysteme vorantreiben.


Was Du bei uns bekommst

  • Urban Sports Club und EGYM Wellpass: Durch unseren Zuschuss kannst du kostengünstig Sport in ganz Deutschland treiben.
  • Corporate Benefits: Nutze kostenfrei zahlreiche Rabatte bei Partnern aus verschiedenen Branchen, um von attraktiven Angeboten zu profitieren.
  • Snacks und Mittagessen: Unser Büro ist mit einer Vielzahl an Snacks ausgestattet und wir laden dich regelmäßig zu kostenfreien Mittagessen ein.
  • Teamevents und Firmenfeiern: Freue dich auf spannende Teamevents und Firmenfeiern.
  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir fördern dein fachliches und berufliches Wachstum mit vielfältigen Chancen.
  • Dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld: Erlebe ein agiles, teamorientiertes Klima mit offenen Kommunikationsstrukturen, in dem du von Tag eins an direkten Einfluss auf Projekte nehmen und aktiv die Zukunft des Unternehmens mitgestalten kannst.
  • Raum für deine Ideen: Deine Ideen sind bei uns nicht nur willkommen, sondern gewünscht – bringe dich ein und gestalte die Zukunft von EMPIT aktiv mit.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Mechatronik oder Physik bzw. eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Hardware- bzw. Elektronikentwicklung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Analogtechnik, Schaltungstechnik, Stromversorgung und Signalverarbeitung
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Optimierung von Platinen (PCB) und elektronischen Baugruppen, idealerweise im Umfeld von Mess- und Signalgeneratoren
  • Ausgeprägte technische Neugier und Innovationsfreude sowie der Mut, bestehende Lösungen neu zu denken und eigene Konzepte einzubringen
  • Hands-on-Mentalität und Freude daran, eigene Lösungen selbst aufzubauen, zu testen, zu messen und zu optimieren
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

title: Security Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at freiheit.com technologies
description_html:
ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY

freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”.

In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”.

85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. 

Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen.
Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr.

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. 

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. 

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.


ÜBER DEINEN JOB
  • Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass Sicherheit ein technisches Thema ist. Deshalb glauben wir, dass nur ein echter Engineer für die Sicherheit bei freiheit.com verantwortlich sein kann. Nur wenn Du weißt, wie die Dinge funktionieren, kannst Du Prozesse und Richtlinien entwerfen, um uns und unsere Daten sicher und geschützt zu halten.
  • Du entwirfst und implementierst die Infrastruktur, damit Du einfache, aber dennoch zuverlässige und sichere Prozesse sowie Richtlinien einführen kannst.
  • Da Du von Herzen Engineer bist, schreibst Du Code, um manuelle Aufgaben zu automatisieren. Du weißt sowieso, dass es der einzige Weg ist.
  • Du bist aber auch für unser ISMS (Information Security Management System) verantwortlich und sorgst dafür, dass dieses stets auf dem neuesten Stand ist und die Regeln und Vorschriften im ISMS sinnvoll und hilfreich sind. Ebenso arbeitest Du mit unserem Datenschutzbeauftragten zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die DSGVO einhalten.
  • Du stärkst unsere Mitglieder auch, indem Du ihnen Sicherheit beibringst. Sowohl durch die Gestaltung von Schulungen als auch durch die Unterstützung bei der Schaffung einer sicheren Infrastruktur in ihren Projekten.
  • Das Jobprofil ist eine tolle Chance für Software Engineers, die ihr Spektrum in Richtung Sicherheit und Compliance erweitern und zudem strategisch arbeiten möchten.
  • Wir glauben auch, dass eine kleine Dosis Zwangsstörung hilfreich sein könnte ;-). Zumindest solltest Du den starken Willen haben, die Dinge richtig zu machen, und sehr sorgfältig bei Deiner Arbeit sein.

    • ÜBER DICH
  • Qualifikationen:
  • Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik, Physik oder Elektrotechnik
  • Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes
  • Erfahrung in der UNIX-Systemadministration und Networking
  • Programmiererfahrung – idealerweise in Go
  • Hoher Einfluss auf den technischen Erfolg Deiner vergangenen Projekte
  • Die Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen
  • Bonus Skills and Interessen:
  • Master oder Doktortitel in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik oder Physik
  • Erfahrung in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS) oder Microsoft Azure
  • Erfahrung mit Observability (Protokollierung, Überwachung, Alarmierung, Rückverfolgung)

title: IT Support Specialist (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at eHealth-Connect GmbH
description_html:
Du hast Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen, behältst auch bei mehreren offenen Themen den Überblick und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären?

Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu dir passen.

Bei eHealth-Connect entwickeln wir digitale Lösungen für die vernetzte Gesundheitsversorgung. Unsere Produkte werden von unterschiedlichen Akteuren im Gesundheitswesen genutzt – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen, wenn Fragen entstehen, Prozesse nicht wie erwartet laufen oder technische Unterstützung benötigt wird.

Dabei geht es bei uns nicht um klassischen Callcenter-Support, sondern darum, Probleme wirklich zu verstehen, strukturiert einzugrenzen und gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Teams Lösungen zu finden.

Warum brauchen wir diese Rolle?

Mit unseren Produkten, Kunden und Anwendungsfällen wächst auch die Zahl der Themen, die im täglichen Betrieb schnell und zuverlässig gelöst werden müssen. Deshalb möchten wir unseren Support weiter professionalisieren und suchen jemanden, der Supportfälle strukturiert übernimmt, technische Zusammenhänge analysiert und dafür sorgt, dass unsere Kund:innen schnell die richtige Unterstützung bekommen. Gleichzeitig bist du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zu unseren technischen und fachlichen Teams: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder, bereitest komplexere Fälle sauber auf und hilfst damit auch uns, unsere Produkte und Prozesse kontinuierlich besser zu machen.

Warum ist die Rolle spannend?

Du bearbeitest bei uns nicht einfach Tickets nach Schema F.

Unsere Lösungen bewegen sich in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld und verbinden Software, unterschiedliche Systeme, Schnittstellen und Prozesse im Gesundheitswesen miteinander. Das bedeutet: Hinter einer Supportanfrage steckt manchmal eine einfache Bedienfrage – manchmal aber auch ein technisches Puzzle. Du lernst unsere Produkte und Systeme sehr genau kennen, arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Deployment und Fachbereichen zusammen und entwickelst mit der Zeit ein gutes Gespür dafür, wo ein Problem entsteht und wie wir es am besten lösen können.

Aufgaben

Was sind deine Aufgaben?

  • Annahme, Erfassung und Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen unserer Kund:innen
  • Unterstützung der Anwender:innen bei Fragen zur Bedienung und zu den Prozessen unserer Produkte
  • Analyse und erste Eingrenzung technischer und fachlicher Fehler
  • Prüfung von Fehlermeldungen, Prozessstatus, Logs und vorhandenen Systeminformationen
  • Klassifizierung und Priorisierung von Supportfällen sowie Überwachung vereinbarter Service Levels
  • Lösung bekannter Störungen anhand vorhandener Dokumentationen und Workarounds
  • Qualifizierte Eskalation komplexerer Fälle an 2nd Level, Entwicklung oder zuständige Fachbereiche
  • Nachvollziehbare Dokumentation von Lösungen und wiederkehrenden Fehlerbildern in unserer Wissensdatenbank

Qualifikation

Was hilft dir, in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein?

Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtig ist uns vor allem, dass du gerne Probleme löst, strukturiert arbeitest und Freude an der Kommunikation mit Menschen hast.

  • Erfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder technischen Kundensupport ist von Vorteil
  • Gutes technisches Verständnis sowie eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen sowie im Umgang mit Fehlermeldungen und Logs
  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie eine klare, freundliche und verbindliche Kommunikation
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Kenntnisse im IT-Service-Management, zum Beispiel nach ITIL v4, sind wünschenswert
  • Grundkenntnisse in Webanwendungen, APIs und JSON sind von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

Uns ist wichtiger, wie du an Probleme herangehst, wie du kommunizierst und ob du Lust hast, dich in unsere Produkte und Technologien einzuarbeiten, als dass du bereits jedes Kästchen erfüllst. Auch der sinnvolle Einsatz von KI im Arbeitsalltag wird bei uns ausdrücklich gefördert und ist bereits Teil unserer Arbeitsweise.

Über eHealth-Connect

Wir entwickeln Software und digitale Lösungen für eine moderne, vernetzte Gesundheitsversorgung. Unsere Technologien verbinden unterschiedliche Akteure und Systeme im Gesundheitswesen und tragen dazu bei, digitale Versorgung einfacher, sicherer und besser nutzbar zu machen.

Dabei arbeiten wir an der Schnittstelle zwischen moderner Softwareentwicklung, Telematikinfrastruktur und neuen digitalen Versorgungskonzepten.

Wir arbeiten hybrid und haben ein modernes Büro in Berlin-Mitte, das wir als Ort für Zusammenarbeit, Austausch und gemeinsame Teamtage nutzen.

Klingt nach etwas, das zu dir passen könnte?

Dann melde dich bei uns. Ob mit Lebenslauf oder einfach ein paar Sätzen darüber, wer du bist, was du bisher gemacht hast und warum dich die Rolle interessiert – wir möchten vor allem dich kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns auf dich.

title: FP&A Analyst
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Kraken
description_html:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in

We are building out a world-class Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to support our rapid global growth. We’re looking for a high-calibre FP&A Analyst with a background in investment banking, private equity, or top-tier strategy or finance roles.

This is a rare chance to move from advisory into operating, where you’ll help shape the trajectory of one of the most ambitious multinational SaaS platforms in the market. You’ll be in the engine room of strategic decision-making, with daily exposure to senior leadership and a clear path to accelerated career growth while at the same time making a big green dent in the world.

🚀 What you’ll own

  • Financial Modelling:  Build simple and pragmatic analysis to answer questions and support recommendations, before the questions arise.  Build and maintain complex models for scenario planning, evaluating potential investments, and assessing risks.

  • Budgeting, Performance Analysis & Forecasting: Help to run the annual budgeting process.  On a monthly and quarterly basis, develop and continuously refine reporting &  KPIs to improve transparency, accountability, and decision-making.  

  • Data guru: Become a master of data sources, respond to ad hoc questions quickly, accurately, and proactively. Develop dashboards into scalable, self service tools.

  • Operational problem solving: Proactively diagnose operational bottlenecks. Deploy tactical, data-driven solutions to remove friction in day-to-day execution.

  • Executive Materials: Prepare high-quality analysis and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Business Partnering: Collaborate with commercial, product, and operations leaders to align financial outcomes with strategic initiatives.

🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Technical & advanced analytics: Advanced Google Sheets or Excel proficiency. SQL. Experience with BI tools like Power BI, Tableau, or specialised FP&A software (e.g., Pigment, Anaplan) is beneficial. 

  • Proven ability to work in ambiguity: You can, with some support, frame a problem, find the right data,  test hypotheses and move forward without waiting for perfect inputs. You can draw out the insights from complex or incomplete data.

  • Business acumen:  You can join the dots between business imperatives, stakeholders’ priorities, and external factors.

  • Communication: You can challenge assumptions constructively and confidently with senior stakeholders.  You can create board-ready and management level materials. 

  • Experience: More than 2 years in investment banking, private equity, strategy consulting, or top-tier corporate finance/FP&A.  

  • Proactive self-starter: The ability to work independently in a fast-moving, scaling environment.

  • Low Ego: You are equally comfortable developing the 3-year plan for the Board as you are digging into broken cell references in a Google sheet.  You are happy to ask for help when you need it, and you jump in to help other people.

  • A "maker": You don’t do things "because that's how they’re done." You ask questions and figure out if there’s another way to do things.

  • You are commercially curious and outcome-focused.

Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5, and in Germany we rate 4.7 on Kununu as a Top Company. Check out our Welcome to the Jungle site (FR/EN) to learn more about our teams and culture.

 

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at ----- We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

*Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice, (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms

title: Solutions Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ultralytics
description_html:
About Ultralytics:

At Ultralytics, we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models. If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.

⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the linkcreators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.

Following our $30M Series A round, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.

We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

💼 About the role
As a Solutions Engineer, you'll turn complex computer vision problems into production systems built on YOLO. You'll lead technical discovery, design architectures, build benchmarks and proof-of-concepts, and guide customers from their first conversation to deployed models.

You'll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering while partnering directly with customers in manufacturing, retail, security, robotics, and beyond. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys writing Python, training and optimizing models, deploying across cloud and edge, and owning outcomes throughout the customer lifecycle.

If you thrive on ambiguous problems, direct customer contact, and turning technical possibilities into measurable results, you'll fit right in.

🚀 What you'll do
Technical discovery and solution design

  • Own technical discovery, translate customer needs into architectures, and define measurable success criteria.

  • Evaluate customer data, recommend models, and design training, inference, and deployment strategies.

  • Lead technical qualification and solution design alongside Account Executives and Customer Success Managers.


Prototyping and deployment

  • Build Python prototypes with YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and Docker.

  • Create benchmarks, integrations, and production-ready training and deployment workflows.

  • Deploy solutions across Linux, macOS, Windows, cloud, and edge environments.

  • Diagnose performance, data quality, inference, and hardware acceleration challenges.

  • Use the Ultralytics documentation and YOLO guides to deliver reliable customer outcomes.


Customer engagement and enablement

  • Deliver technical demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and proof-of-concepts that move opportunities forward.

  • Explain machine learning clearly to engineers, operators, executives, and other non-technical audiences.

  • Build trusted relationships and manage technical stakeholders from evaluation through production.


Ecosystem contribution

  • Turn customer solutions into reusable examples, deployment guides, integrations, and documentation.

  • Share feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the YOLO ecosystem.

  • Engage developers through the Ultralytics community and GitHub organization.


📈 What success looks like

  • 3 months: Ramped on the YOLO stack and customers, co-running discovery, and delivering your first demos and project kickoffs.

  • 6 months: Owning technical discovery and POCs end to end, unblocking live deals or at-risk accounts, and earning trust from the AEs and CSMs you support.

  • 9 months: Converting technical evaluations into wins or saves, shipping reusable assets, and providing actionable feedback to the wider organization.

  • 12 months: Becoming the technical partner AEs and CSMs want on their biggest accounts, with POCs that convert and referenceable customer deployments.


🧠 Skills and experience
Core requirements

  • Strong Python and practical experience with YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and computer vision.

  • Experience training, optimizing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models.

  • Comfortable with Docker, Git, REST APIs, Linux, cloud platforms, and edge workflows.

  • Experience deploying across Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.

  • Proven ability to deliver technical demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and POCs.

  • Strong communication skills with both technical and executive audiences.

  • Independent ownership, urgency, resilience, and results in a high-performance startup environment.

  • Passion for AI, open source, and helping customers achieve real outcomes.


Nice to have

  • Kubernetes, CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX, Jetson, or other edge accelerators.

  • Experience with MLOps, model monitoring, CI/CD, or observability.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, GCP, serverless systems, or managed inference platforms.

  • Experience integrating OpenAI or Anthropic APIs into customer tools.

  • Open-source contributions or experience supporting developer communities.

  • Knowledge of Ultralytics YOLO workflows and production computer vision solutions.


🌟 Why this role

  • Real impact: Your solutions will power vision AI in production across systems used by millions of devices.

  • Demand you don't have to manufacture: YOLO is the world's most popular computer vision model, and customers already come to us looking to do more with it.

  • Build at the source: Work directly on top of the YOLO ecosystem with clear lines to Product and Engineering.

  • A team that ships: Join a fast-moving, high-standard team that values results over routine.

  • Customer ownership: Stay involved beyond the demo and see your technical work reach production.


🚫 What this isn't
This isn't a slideware Solutions Engineer role. You won't hand off after the demo or hide behind a deck — you'll build the solution, get it deployed, and own the technical outcome throughout the client lifecycle.

🌟 Cultural fit
At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.

  • Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

  • Value excellence, grit, and creativity in equal measure.

  • See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress.

💰 Compensation and benefits
We reward excellence and impact — not just tenure or title.

  • Competitive compensation: Competitive compensation packages

  • On-site collaboration: Work with passionate builders in one of our global hubs (London).

  • Flexible working hours: We value results over routines.

  • Generous time off: 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays.

  • Tech & tools: Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices.

  • Gear: Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3.

  • Learning & development: Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth.

  • High impact: Your work will shape the future of vision AI.


👉 Check out Ultralytics careers and our office locations to learn more about our culture, values, and teams.

🌎 Where and how you can work
We believe great work happens where passion meets purpose.

  • This is a full-time, on-site role based in London, UK.

  • Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country of application.

  • You will report to the Head of Customer Success and Implementation.

What we offer:
